| | | **_Learn More About Chuck_**

---
---
| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

name: Adam Kinzinger
subject: We did it again
body:
| Hi Friend -- On Sunday night, nearly 1,000 members joined our virtual Oath & Duty Campfire and it was a great time... even if the breakout rooms, once again, struggled under the the weight of our awesome movement! We discussed the exciting work Country First is doing in Michigan, which is ground zero for MAGA's war on democracy, and launched a new "American Dream" video that will be promoted there. You can check it out [here](https://www.country1st.com/americandream?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=oath_campfire_noshow_nd&n=1). I hope you'll share it with anyone you think would appreciate the message (no matter where they live!) [](https://www.country1st.com/americandream?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=oath_campfire_noshow_nd&n=2) If you're interested in getting involved with our Michigan effort on-the-ground or virtually from home (in any state), [please fill out this form](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=FHnL8ikUv8WviObJjkW8kTR7ozFiVSYhzSu-2EwIkQCMYktu7LRD64S5wMOLxTDhdQzzMUI3gwU-L68KrkRROfM2gdf9U2WtGrHsQUb5JUyVzfTSpUcN1OXSIFie8IAC6oOjBpol15Wd8QLYRCvnEw&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=oath_campfire_noshow_nd&n=3) and my team will be in touch. My inbox has been filled with notes from people who loved their conversations last night with others from all over the country and all across the political spectrum. Fortunately, it doesn't have to stop there. We actually have a [private troll-free ](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6sAbiimTwRd6ssr23ZzK-qLNKlsAAN6GQt_CjSeXswXh&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=oath_campfire_noshow_nd&n=4)[Facebook](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6sAbiimTwRd6ssr23ZzK-qLNKlsAAN6GQt_CjSeXswXh&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=oath_campfire_noshow_nd&n=5)[ community](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6sAbiimTwRd6ssr23ZzK-qLNKlsAAN6GQt_CjSeXswXh&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=oath_campfire_noshow_nd&n=6) with great conversations unfolding constantly. And our state chapters and national volunteer committees are all organized in our [Slack](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=20iWOqDLwEfcLKJhIQ2LLC7Qj9FIWOAlDqWLyImboJFiIHCwpOeqd_AUG-av1p_Cpr3IP8PpnRSpP9RECEq0GA6rBINCCn7IfEu_7lnA1t3TJLOZYr8rvyZInAysv1mI&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=oath_campfire_noshow_nd&n=7) channel, where you can find other members from your state who put Country over Party. Please check both out if you haven't already. Finally, we've launched a new line of merchandise in our shop called "[Cancel Conspiracies](https://www.country1st.com/shop?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=oath_campfire_noshow_nd&n=8)", and is a great way to send a message and wear your values out in the world. Take a look and consider ordering \-- all proceeds go toward building this movement. [](https://www.country1st.com/shop?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=oath_campfire_noshow_nd&n=9) Thanks again for everything! Country First, Adam PS: If you're finding value in Country First, the greatest gift would be helping to spread the word. This link is actually unique to you, so we'll know who to thank when your friends and family sign up, so send it around: https://www.country1st.com/americandream?recruiter_id=91510
---

To stop receiving emails, [click here](https://www.country1st.com/unsubscribe?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=oath_campfire_noshow_nd&n=10).

subject: Humbly asking you to read this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7170akg12fgqhhri5q7vih9g9qe8snj6dkjuqvo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sji66o33cph238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2sjlemo72sjk6ipr7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65t9me1jjas5lmco7fd5me5rmfchgsion9ork6ji7co3165hb1cj6c3jrddj0edgefkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3c1p30pjimipm6ptmcpj30s5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zeqhhv97tpqr71rnpr2o9srr9m16uo7vsiuq1mt8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sji66o33cph2bs)
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z151f8uon6umef1rf8e0sgt44ogflbl4150lonfo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sji66o33cph2bs)
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zuh4m8gbh6ud7rpnv59d25d2i6uk4aegnafkp4g0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sji66o33cph2bs)
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zimi1opll8npc70caimndo34l7u4f3p7q31ghe88_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sji66o33cph2bs)
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zda2unsdmccnttdb5mbem5pg77tm5nj2bgil6iug_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sji66o33cph2bs)
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8cffksrpidqd1ut1uhl5vnkphva4npna6kk6l30_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sji66o33cph2bs)**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zbi7o1g0bpemah0u84urn5qpiqvkhqqt3tj6ehao_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sji66o33cph2bs)
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |
* * *
---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zr94eiq1i50b40i0l0l42o9rbaeajs1m8s4ftcdg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sji66o33cph2bs)
---
I talk to folks every day who say they haven't donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn't close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we're only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference.

**[Please, can you give $4, 8, $12.55, or $17 today?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z19r218mb2bftdj3tthlsduu0399d1ars0kv69b0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sji66o33cph2bs)**

We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...). | All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted. I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did. My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me. | After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support. I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream. | This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream. I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from. Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream. | | | Thank you so much for taking the time to read this, Marco Rubio | | | | | | I talk to folks every day who say they haven't donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn't close. Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we're only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads. With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference. ** | | | | | Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate PO Box 530650 Miami, FL 33153 If dpwillis67@gmail.com should not be subscribed or if you need to change your subscription information for Trumptrainnews, . 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

In January 2019, after Congresswoman Sharice Davids defeated a Republican incumbent and flipped her House seat from Red to Blue, she became one of the first two Native American women ever to serve in the U.S. Congress and the first LGBTQ member of Congress in Kansas history. Today, she is serving her second term as a successful, battle tested and reelected frontliner who is delivering jobs and opportunity for her constituents throughout her district and across Kansas.

We look forward to a discussion on Congresswoman Davids’ work in Congress and the fight that is happening right now back in Kansas to protect reproductive freedom since the Supreme Court’s Dobbs ruling took down Roe v. Wade and eviscerated the right of privacy recognized by decades of its own precedents.

Congresswoman Davids will tell us all about the upcoming Kansas constitutional amendment ballot measure that seeks to strip away the right to reproductive freedom that now exists in Kansas and about her hard work and leadership in protecting other rights that were also threatened by Dobbs, including marriage equality.

Her fight for freedom and justice is only matched by her fight to bring opportunity to every corner of her district and state. Congresswoman Davids works to secure a fair shot for workers, improved health care, preserving Native lands, and bringing opportunity to underserved communities. She delivered on infrastructure for #KS03 to tackle overdue projects and create thousands of good-paying jobs locally.

Rep. Davids works every day to address the kitchen table needs of working families back home who are dealing with rising costs and supply chain issues as she delivers solutions and community investments that are bringing new American manufacturing jobs back to the heartland for the first time in a long time. Because of her leadership, historic Kansas City investments are being made to meet present needs and set a foundation for future growth by connecting workers to opportunity.

Congresswoman David’s leadership on infrastructure and focus on how the infrastructure law is being implemented throughout Kansas have made a real difference for underserved communities and an unprecedented impact in tribal communities throughout the state. Congresswoman Davids is a leader and we are thrilled to have her join us tomorrow night!

Please RSVP here:

https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/1016437740912/WN_nfzPhPFJSB-aysxyipH4yw

As always, thank you for your ongoing support of the work of our House Democrats! Your advocacy and mobilization make all the difference and give us the strength and optimism to keep fighting for our Freedoms!

Thank you,

NANCY

Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
As the top Democrat in the House, she's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy.

body:
We’ve been told our whole lives to eat lots of fruits, veggies, and whole grains to stay healthy.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztic0pv8nfv3cf542o1pjnh4tkhsss9ech6d7aqo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2usqb9otkmsr35cpi6dr30srj6dqm3c7265gb9c9nmppn3c32e3hb7c5nclh3cc77q9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphhmsqj9ptimpj3cp5l6jjr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or5c3ie4or0sjie49fg)
We’ve been told our whole lives to eat lots of fruits, veggies, and whole grains to stay healthy.
However, according to Dr. Steven Gundry — a world-renowned heart surgeon — many of the so-called “health foods” in our diets actually contain a harmful toxin that could be expanding your waistline.
“This nasty toxin can rip tiny tears throughout your entire gut lining,” says Dr. Gundry. “This then allows harmful bacteria and waste products to seep into your bloodstream and wreak havoc on your body.”
**Today, new research shows this common affliction is currently affecting millions of people nationwide. The common warning signs include fatigue, digestive discomfort, weight gain, brain fog, achy joints, tired muscles, and sometimes even skin problems.**
“These common health problems are often mistaken as normal signs of getting older,” explains Dr. Gundry. “But I can assure you, the harm caused by this little-known toxin is far from normal.”
The good news is, this problem can easily be fixed at home.
“It’s very simple, you just have to know which foods are actually healthy, and which foods contain this hidden toxin,” explains Dr. Gundry.
By simply eliminating this toxin, he has seen thousands of his own patients achieve remarkable turnarounds. (In fact, he even lost 70lbs himself and has kept the weight off ever since.)
Now, after years of research, Dr. Gundry has decided to release a short video to the public — free and uninterrupted — showcasing exactly which foods you and your loved ones should avoid.
“Our health is our greatest gift,” he explains. “So if this video helps people look better and feel better, I’m thrilled to be of service.”
The video has since gone viral, first being shared by users on Facebook, then being featured on news sites like ABC and CBS.
So far, the comments and feedback have been encouraging, with thousands of Americans feeling better than they have in decades.
[Click here to watch the presentation.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zefgmjptpsdl9vu0k7l58km6da1fh0g2ogbh62fo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sjh66o74sjh2bs)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0ipahrt4930ce1ch7c92g2nn9do3q9dp0grlsto_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sjh66o74sjh2bs)
Dr. Gundry also serves as the personal physician to many A-list celebrities.
Most notable of which include legendary self-help guru Tony Robbins, Academy Award-winning actor Alan Arkin, Grammy Award-winning singer Usher, and countless Fortune 500 executives.
But you don’t have to be a celebrity to look and feel better using the tips in this video.
There’s just one thing Dr. Gundry asks from his viewers:
“If watching this helps you take control of your weight, increase your energy, ease gas and bloating, or find relief from stiff, achy joints... then please consider sharing this video with your loved ones at some point. Because together, we can help as many people as possible avoid these frustrating health issues.”
[Watch his presentation here.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkg1n9cfcfmi2ru6q8810hbkhs05kh1qvmlcaoig_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sjh66o74sjh2bs)
**Everyone’s body is unique, so individual results can vary.

Friend, my work in the Senate is guided by the timeless and powerful Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to repair and improve the world. So today, I want to take just a moment to share a little bit more about my faith with you.
I am the proud granddaughter of Jewish immigrants. From a young age, my family taught me the values of hard work, determination, and persistence – and I learned how Jewish women have been holding our communities together and taking a stand against injustice from the time of the Torah to today.
Now, as both the third Jewish woman Senator in U.S. history, and the only former synagogue president in the U.S. Senate, **I'm proud to carry these values with me in everything I do to serve Nevada and our country.**
And in this present moment, we're facing no shortage of issues – many of which directly impact women and the Jewish community. From growing antisemitism to attacks on abortion rights, to attacks on our very democracy, I know it's my duty to respond with clear resolve and a commitment to social justice.
If we truly want to repair the world, then it’s up to all of us to come together, roll up our sleeves, and do the repairing.
**There is so much work ahead of us to make this nation better – for ourselves and for future generations.** **[So if the principle of Tikkun Olam resonates with you – if you're with me in the fight to make real progress for our country – I hope you'll chip in $5 or more today to help me continue this critical work in the Senate.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48373393/358009161/610767770?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1902-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NGUwMzM5Yy1iMTBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=X3zlK35VlS2CrJQwfI6wlsaZp5UH69jc9KasDpSFkpY=)**

We’ve been told our whole lives to eat lots of fruits, veggies, and whole grains to stay healthy.
However, according to Dr. Steven Gundry — a world-renowned heart surgeon — many of the so-called “health foods” in our diets actually contain a harmful toxin that could be expanding your waistline.
“This nasty toxin can rip tiny tears throughout your entire gut lining,” says Dr. Gundry. “This then allows harmful bacteria and waste products to seep into your bloodstream and wreak havoc on your body.”
**Today, new research shows this common affliction is currently affecting millions of people nationwide. The common warning signs include fatigue, digestive discomfort, weight gain, brain fog, achy joints, tired muscles, and sometimes even skin problems.**
“These common health problems are often mistaken as normal signs of getting older,” explains Dr. Gundry. “But I can assure you, the harm caused by this little-known toxin is far from normal.”
The good news is, this problem can easily be fixed at home.
“It’s very simple, you just have to know which foods are actually healthy, and which foods contain this hidden toxin,” explains Dr. Gundry.

Friend,

In my regular focus groups with Republican voters, I always make sure to ask who these voters think should run for president in 2024. Until recently, the majority of the group's participants would tell me Trump should run again. Who? Glad you asked. Josh was my General Counsel on the Senate Judiciary Committee from 2011 – 2014 and is now running for an open House seat in upstate New York. Even during a period of partisan gridlock, Josh and I successfully got two bills through Congress and signed by the President. One created new rights for survivors of domestic violence. The other provided new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs.

Josh grew up in Upstate New York in a working-class family. His entire career has been dedicated to making life better for people who don’t have people fighting for them. Get to know Josh and what he stands for [_**here**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48383777/358048916/-1126184350?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83ODM2NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZDU2YzRmNi1jMDBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_iLcZd-zRVlmVbOkigIgyX66awZ6xCbgyuhPsION8mM=&emci=91e9393b-ff0c-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=9d56c4f6-c00d-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=30464261). I was fortunate to have had many, many brilliant, dedicated staffers during my years in the Senate. None was better than Josh. And I can’t think of one who would make a more effective member of Congress.

More often than not, I was the best-prepared member of the Judiciary Committee. That’s because I took my work very seriously, and so did Josh. That said, we had fun.

Josh’s seat is a new one, created during redistricting. In a year where every seat will count, this is a toss-up district that is a MUST-win for Democrats.

Thanks for your attention.

Al

**P.S.** No other former staff member of mine is running for Congress. So, this is the last one of these!

name: Eddie Gallagher, Pipe Hitter Foundation
subject: 25 years for a crime he did not commit
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
Dear Fellow American, My name is Eddie Gallagher, I'm a former Navy SEAL who's twenty year career of fighting for our country came to an abrupt end when corrupt prosecutors tried to lock me up on false charges. After years of sucessfully fighting to clear my name I started Pipe Hitter Foundation to help other soldiers and first responders who are being unjustly prosecuted just for doing their job. _And today I have a shocking story to tell you_. I am reaching out to share this story about **Ben Darby - A wrongly accused officer in-need of our support. ** Ben was a well-trained Huntsville police officer who was forced to make a difficult split-second decision while responding to a dangerous 911 call. The situation was cleared by the Incident Review Board, and Ben's actions were deemed justified. It was determined that he followed all applicable policies and laws. However, soon after Ben was cleared, the Huntsville District Attorney began to use him and his case as a political football. They offered him multiple plea deals, but Ben Darby firmly believed his actions were justified and resisted all pleas. **_Ben was sentenced to 25 years in prison for a crime he did not commit. He is not eligible for an appeal bond due to the excessive sentence he was given. He is stuck serving day-for-day until his appeal comes through. _**
---
[](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
[**Support Officer Ben Darby**](http://trk.readactnews._Qg)
---
The Pipe Hitter Foundation (PHF) was founded to defend the rights and freedoms of our men and women in uniform - The same rights and freedoms they risk their lives to uphold.**This is why we support Ben Darby in his fight for justice, and are requesting your aid to help him get through this time of need and clear his name.** **[Please help us reach our Campaign Goal of $100,000 to support Officer Ben Darby during this time of financial difficulty, as court fees and additional expenses quickly add-up. Chip-in $10, $25, $50, $100, $250, $500 or more today to help Ben clear his name.](http://trk.readactnews._VUmwRoYxe_QFBMBpa0AGA)**
---
[](http://trk.readactnews.-avr-g)
---
[**Support Officer Ben Darby**](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
The District Attorney wrongfully charged Ben with murder, which kicked-off a years-long prosecution that became riddled with ethical lapses, prosecutorial misconduct, errant rulings and politics. **Officer Darby's jury was prevented from hearing relevant testimony from witnesses that would have exonerated him.** Ben and his wife, Keelin Darby, are now in the fight of their lives to appeal this ruling and request a fair shot at justice. The PHF team has set a campaign goal of $100,000 to help Officer Darby pay-off court fees, legal expenses, and other additional costs. Ben risked his life every day on the job to help others - Now it's our turn to give him the help he urgently needs. **Officer Ben Darby is facing unfair legal and financial hardships. He urgently needs our support. PHF is here to help, but we can** '**t do it without aid from supportive community members like you. ** **[Our men and women in blue deserve so much more than this. Please contribute $25, $50, $100, $250, $500 or any amount to support Officer Ben Darby and other first responders like him today.](http://trk.readactnews.)**
---
[](http://trk.readactnews.-vLJLo_Xj6U4MgA)
---
[**Support Officer Ben Darby**](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
The Darby's fight isn't about just one officer. It is about the 800,000 sworn law enforcement officers whose split-second actions during life-or-death situations are judged. They deserve a fair, complete, and impartial justice guaranteed to everyone under our Constitution. PHF provides immediate and ongoing financial and legal support to service members, first responders and their families when they need it most - **And right now, Ben and Keelin Darby urgently need our support.** [**Join us today to support Officer Ben Darby.**](http://trk.readactnews._YgtA) Thank You, \- Eddie Eddie Gallagher Director of Operations Pipe Hitter Foundation

They offered him multiple plea deals, but Ben Darby firmly believed his actions were justified and resisted all pleas. Ben was sentenced to 25 years in prison for a crime he did not commit. He is not eligible for an appeal bond due to the excessive sentence he was given. He is stuck serving day-for-day until his appeal comes through. The Pipe Hitter Foundation (PHF) was founded to defend the rights and freedoms of our men and women in uniform - The same rights and freedoms they risk their lives to uphold.This is why we support Ben Darby in his fight for justice, and are requesting your aid to help him get through this time of need and clear his name. The District Attorney wrongfully charged Ben with murder, which kicked-off a years-long prosecution that became riddled with ethical lapses, prosecutorial misconduct, errant rulings and politics. Officer Darby's jury was prevented from hearing relevant testimony from witnesses that would have exonerated him. Ben and his wife, Keelin Darby, are now in the fight of their lives to appeal this ruling and request a fair shot at justice. The PHF team has set a campaign goal of $100,000 to help Officer Darby pay-off court fees, legal expenses, and other additional costs. Ben risked his life every day on the job to help others - Now it's our turn to give him the help he urgently needs. Officer Ben Darby is facing unfair legal and financial hardships. He urgently needs our support. PHF is here to help, but we can 't do it without aid from supportive community members like you. The Darby's fight isn't about just one officer. It is about the 800,000 sworn law enforcement officers whose split-second actions during life-or-death situations are judged. They deserve a fair, complete, and impartial justice guaranteed to everyone under our Constitution. PHF provides immediate and ongoing financial and legal support to service members, first responders and their families when they need it most - And right now, Ben and Keelin Darby urgently need our support. name: Admiral Mike Franken
subject: attacked for serving in the Navy
body:
Will you split a donation of $25 or more right now between my campaign and CommonGood – every dollar you can afford before our critical fundraising deadline – to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvafranken?refcode=20220727_CGVA_Franken]
Derek,
When Donald Trump was elected, I submitted my request to retire from the U.S. Navy after nearly 4 decades of military service. I never expected I’d one day run for office, but I felt called to continue to serve in whatever way was most meaningful.
People told me to prepare myself – to prepare my family – for what lay ahead. They warned me of the nasty attacks, that politics is a ‘blood sport.’ I never thought a Super PAC would run over a million dollars in TV ads attacking me for serving in the U.S. Navy, but that’s exactly what happened.
They tried to say that because my military service took me and my family from state-to-state, from country-to-country, that I somehow wasn’t an Iowan anymore. They pretended my upbringing in rural, northwest Iowa never happened. They ignored the sacrifices that my wife, my kids, and my family made in my service.
And worst of all, they attacked and denigrated every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, and sometimes spend holidays thousands of miles away from each other.
Now, I’m taking on an even greater challenge. And in my campaign to defeat Republican Senator Chuck Grassley, things are going to get even nastier. I am sure of it, because control of the Senate hinges on our race and whether or not we can turn Iowa blue.
In order to be ready to fight back, we need to raise another $50,000 before our critical fundraising deadline, but right now, we’re still falling pretty short. I’m not taking money from corporate PACs, so if we’re going to have the resources we need to win, I’m counting on grassroots donors like you to give right now:
I wouldn’t ask if it weren’t important: Please, will you split a donation of $25 or more right now between my campaign and CommonGood – every dollar you can afford before our critical fundraising deadline – to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority? body:

Hi again, Peter. It's Alex, Trudy's campaign manager. This email is a bit longer than my usual messages, so it'd mean so much to me if you’d take a moment to read it.
A while back, I promised myself that I wouldn't work on a race this election cycle. I love life on the campaign trail, but it's not easy. The long hours and the constant demands of campaigns require us staffers to put most everything else on hold.
**But when I heard from Trudy, I knew I couldn't say no. **
There is so much at stake this year – the right to abortion, voting rights, stopping hyper-partisanship, and more. It's a scary time, and as a native Missourian, I'm deeply worried about the future of my home state. So when I met Trudy, I knew she was the person to tackle it all and lead us forward.
It's hard to put into words what exactly it is about Trudy that won me over so quickly. **There are a lot of big picture things – she's kind but holds firm to her beliefs, she's both compassionate and determined, fierce yet gentle, and honest through and through.** But it's also the little things that mean so much. In fact, as I write this email, I'm drinking a coffee that Trudy brought me personally – that's just who she is.
You see, Trudy's the type of person who notices when people on her team or in her state need help – whether it's help staying awake during a long day of work, help affording childcare as costs keep rising, or help paying for prescription drugs and accessing quality healthcare. **She notices, she listens, and then she takes action.** That's what makes her such an excellent nurse and such a loving mother – and why I know that she's going to be the next senator from Missouri.
I joined this team because Trudy is exactly what Washington needs and because I know she will do right by our great state. **I'm all in for Trudy, and tonight I'm asking you to join me.[Please, will you pitch in $5 right now to send this compassionate and sincere nurse's heart to the U.S. Senate? body:
Conservatives are holding up judicial appointments with blue slips
| | | | |
---
| | |

| | |

| |
---
| | | | | Peter, Not happy with how the Supreme Court has been acting lately? Me neither. But Supreme Court nominees usually come from the ranks of judges in lower courts. During Trump’s term in office, Republicans waved through unqualified and unhinged judges, one after another, often into vacancies they’d held open during the Obama administration. Now they’re stonewalling and foot-dragging again, using the prerogative of Senators to put a “blue slip” hold on presidential nominees. They’re clearly hoping to be able to hold those judgeships open for the next Republican president to get back to packing the lower courts with the next crop of terrible Supreme Court nominees. Tired of this? [Write the Senate, and ask them to fix the rules so Biden can fill these critical positions.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4ea24857-7f91-46da-8ffe-0c5edd5852ca/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | In just a few short days this spring, the Supreme Court stripped away the rights of millions of Americans. Though the decision was both backwards and devastating, Justice Clarence Thomas openly invited _further_ attacks on our rights to privacy. I'm going to tell you how Democrats in the House have been working to correct these wrongs and prevent the next round, but if you're ready to support the fight right now, please [**donate $13 before our end of month fundraising deadline on Sunday.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48387423/358062876/-821065315?refcode=2022-07-27-eom1&recurring=0&amount=13&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=b70145d0-c70d-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNzAxNDVkMC1jNzBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Akpz0AjnyqXX6JrJNz2C6A5fm4Gg8agLLMRTFcx2j9o=) So far this year:

And after Justice Thomas said that the Supreme Court should revisit past rulings regarding marriage equality and the right to birth control, we took action.
* **The House passed a bill ensuring marriage equality is protected at the federal level. I voted YES.**

Americans should have the right to marry whom they love. That shouldn't be controversial, and it definitely shouldn't be used as a political football.
* **And then, the House passed a bill ensuring Americans' have access to birth control. I voted YES.**

When Justice Thomas said he wanted to take away a woman's right to birth control, some just assumed that was just his opinion. **But when the bill came to the floor for a vote,****_195 of House Republicans voted against it_****.** This is not just an opinion of one man. This has been Washington Republicans' plan all along. [**We must fight back at the ballot box. So, I'm asking, will you chip in $13 toward our July goal? Though the decision was both backwards and devastating, Justice Clarence Thomas openly invited further attacks on our rights to privacy. I'm going to tell you how Democrats in the House have been working to correct these wrongs and prevent the next round, but if you're ready to support the fight right now, please = So far this year: The House has passed the Women's Health Protection Act protecting reproductive rights at the federal level. I voted YES. And after Justice Thomas said that the Supreme Court should revisit past rulings regarding marriage equality and the right to birth control, we took action. The House passed a bill ensuring marriage equality is protected at the federal level. I voted YES. Americans should have the right to marry whom they love. That shouldn't be controversial, and it definitely shouldn't be used as a political football. And then, the House passed a bill ensuring Americans' have access to birth control. I voted YES. When Justice Thomas said he wanted to take away a woman's right to birth control, some just assumed that was just his opinion. But when the bill came to the floor for a vote,**195 of House Republicans voted against it. This is not just an opinion of one man. This has been Washington Republicans' plan all along. = Congressional Republicans have made it clear they intend to pursue a nationwide abortion ban, and their handpicked justices have signalled that they're on board. We need a strong Democratic majority in Congress to protect Americans' rights from this hyper-politicized Supreme Court. = Thank you for being part of the team. There aren’t words to describe the pain, hurt, and anger we all feel. Roe v. Wade is overturned. But we will organize, galvanize, mobilize – and we will not give up. And this is just the beginning. That’s why Maggie Hassan’s race in New Hampshire has never been more important to the future of our country. I've been proud to work alongside Maggie. She has been an integral voice in the Senate, and we need to make sure she wins her reelection and can keep fighting for families like yours, friend. Look, Maggie's facing a tough battle ahead of her as she fights to win one of the tightest races in the country. Mitch McConnell is reaching deep into the bottomless pockets of his dark-money allies to target Maggie's race – so we can't take her integral voice in the Senate for granted. #
I’ll be honest, Peter. In a moment, **[I’m going to ask you to split a contribution between Senator Durbin's campaign and my campaign ahead of our end-of-month fundraising deadline.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48388724/358068171/-1874817258?refcode=dd_em_220727_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5YjA3MWU4OS1jZDBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9NaU5lL75aE7bsRHZ7WbMMeWerYL-T7Kx3MpHeONgvw=) **But first, I hope you will give me a chance to explain why your support is so important.
Thanks to folks like you, our campaign won one of the closest races in the nation in 2020, helping to secure Democratic majorities in both houses of Congress.
Since then, we’ve made some incredible progress together — from lowering health insurance costs and premiums through the _Health Care Affordability Act_ , to securing a once-in-a-generation investment in modernizing our infrastructure.
**We still have a lot of work to do, and Peter, I’m nowhere near finished fighting for the people of Illinois. But we have another tough reelection battle ahead of us, and I’ll need you by my side every step of the way.**
The NRCC has named me a top-target in their fight to flip the House majority and they’ve already begun to launch attacks at our campaign. And as a result of our state’s redistricting process, **70% of the voters we’ll be talking to in our district are brand new, and have never had my name on their ballot before.**
I’ll be honest, winning this election won’t be a walk in the park. It will take a lot of resources to expand our outreach efforts and spread our message to new voters, all while fighting back against right-wing attacks. But I’ve seen what this team is capable of, and together, I know we can overcome these new challenges and make history once again.
**So, here comes the part where I ask: Will you split a donation between my re-election campaign and Senator Durbin's? Your support has made the difference for our campaign time and again.**

body:
NationBuilder
Maggie Hassan's Anti-American Energy agenda

| Don't let her [ad full of lies](https://www.nh.gop/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRZU2dJtpbLebsiv-wOwIPM_&e=3b759f8f09083dafc3b676ab7322a136&utm_source=nhgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=week_1_gas_prices&n=1) fool you, Maggie Hassan and Joe Biden are hand-in-hand when it comes to **not** releasing more American oil and putting Americans into deeper debt. Maggie Hassan knows she's in trouble with NH voters, so she chooses to lie to appease to them instead. This is what Maggie _says_ : This is what Maggie _does:_
1. **Voted for** a methane tax that would increase costs for oil and gas producers by up to $10 billion per year.
2. **Voted against** approval of the Keystone XL pipeline.
3. **Voted against** legislation to prohibit a ban on fracking in the U.S.
4. **Voted against** allowing drilling in ANWR.
5. **Voted against** expanding natural gas production in the U.S.

Maggie says she's pushing Biden to release more of our oil reserves, yet she has continuously been in lockstep with Joe Biden and his Anti-American energy agenda. Hassan's correct about one thing--releasing more American oil will lower costs. If only she didn't agree to do the exact opposite of that.
* * *
Joe Biden can't stop excitingly tweeting about how he should get credit for the recent decrease in gas prices. Yet, our previous president never let gas prices get above $3.00. Let's not forget that gas prices under Joe Biden were the **HIGHEST** in the country's history.
* * *
**The Joe Biden reality:**
* Gas prices are still overwhelmingly high.
* Joe Biden would rather travel to Saudi Arabia and beg for oil, than tap into the oil reserves in the U.S.
* Joe Biden would rather give jobs to Saudi Arabians than provide job security to the U.S.'s own oil workers.

**The Maggie Hassan reality:**
* She'd rather lie to NH citizens about trying to lower costs than _actually_ following through.
* She votes with Joe Biden 96.2% of the time, always agreeing with him in voting on oil policy.
* If NH re-elects her this November, we're in for more lies and larger burns in our wallets.

The Joe Biden Anti-American energy agenda is the Maggie Hassan Anti-American energy agenda; both are continuously making Granite Stater's lives harder. NHGOP Press & Communications

Hey there, (please read email attached)

I hope you'll take a moment to read the entire email, then consider donating $5 to support my campaign to fight for an America that upholds our values and where all are welcome.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48391162/358075524/-812518710?refcode=em-7.27.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjkyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhY2ZjMjE1OS1kMjBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HM4LM2ys6GTZucOexNbp8zBpy_eiZ_7n_xxZaQZeZXI=)** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48391163/358075525/-812518710?refcode=em-7.27.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjkyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhY2ZjMjE1OS1kMjBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HM4LM2ys6GTZucOexNbp8zBpy_eiZ_7n_xxZaQZeZXI=) _With my graduating medical school class in Pakistan._ I was raised in a rural village in Eastern Pakistan. I loved my community, but I learned early on our society had deep issues. You couldn't imagine the hatred many held for the Jewish and LGBTQ communities. # **[Rep. Mayra Flores (TX-34)](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=984abd914f&e=659fba240e)[ Endorses](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=72a36fe216&e=659fba240e)[ Juan for AZ-06](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=a67fca6a4c&e=659fba240e)**
_With only 5 seats needed to flip the U.S. House of Representatives, Arizona's 6th congressional district is a key district! _
"I am proud to endorse Juan Ciscomani for Arizona's 6th congressional district. **Juan understands the values that make the United States the land of opportunity and he will fight to preserve the American Dream for our kids and grandkids.** But today's policies coming out of Washington do not represent our community and are hurting families. Juan is living the American Dream and only America offers this opportunity to people with Juan’s story and mine. I look forward to serving together."
—**REP. MAYRA FLORES (TX-34)** [](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=4caa1c5fc5&e=659fba240e) Rep. name: Alex Lasry
subject: Today, I am ending my campaign and endorsing my friend Mandela Barnes for Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lasry for Wisconsin **[alexlasry
body:
The stakes are just too high to wait. | |
---
Peter,

The stakes are just too high. We know the single best thing we can do for Wisconsin, and for America, is to beat Ron Johnson, and that must start now.

I have said since the first day that I got into this race I wanted to run a positive campaign that focused on why vote for me and not why not one of our primary opponents.

I am proud of the statewide campaign we built and the way we did it. We built a strong team, grounded in support from our friends in organized labor and working people from all 72 counties. We became the first statewide campaign ever in Wisconsin to have a unionized staff.

We lived out our values and spent the last 18 months talking about the issues that mattered to Wisconsinites and the ways that we could make their lives better.

Because of all of this, even though we started this campaign at essentially zero — we built a deep well of support that grew into a strong second place in the polls.

But it’s become clear in the last few weeks that Wisconsin voters have decided that they want Lt. Governor Mandela Barnes to be our Democratic nominee for US Senate.

When the Lt. Governor got into the race, I welcomed him to the race as someone who has been my friend and someone I have supported in the past. **And now, after a year of running against one another, I am proud to still call Mandela my friend, and in a few months, I will be proud to call him Senator Mandela Barnes.**

The primary is two weeks away, but we, as a party, cannot wait. The problem with late primaries is that it often leaves the winning candidate out of money and with a fractured party.

**_We cannot allow that to happen._**

**Today, I am ending my campaign and endorsing my friend, Mandela Barnes, to be the next great Senator from the State of Wisconsin.**

I’m calling for all Wisconsin Democrats to come together now behind Mandela and make sure we have a laser focus on beating Ron Johnson and reelecting Governor Tony Evers this November.

Thank you for everything,

Alex Lasry
---

Serving the people of New Hampshire as State Senator, Governor, and now U.S. Senator has been the honor of my life. And I'm committed to continue delivering on the issues that matter most to Granite Staters.

He used to look over the corner of his newspaper at the breakfast table and ask my siblings and me, “What are you doing for freedom today?” That’s a big question for three kids who are just trying to finish their cereal before the school bus arrives, but it’s one I think about to this day – and make a point to answer. As the race hits a crescendo, national media attention is picking up. Yesterday, Molly was featured on Meet the Press. **[Click here to watch!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48379997/358034178/784767828?t=2205&sourceid=1071963&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYWIxZjQ2MC1iYjBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=L-2gCoww1lrzjHQa2dLD5V37zy9ttS_GVRPlkFSryPU=&emci=34e82abf-af0d-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=0ab1f460-bb0d-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=43402276)** This positive press comes on the heels of two major editorial endorsements by trusted Vermont publications – the [St. Albans Messenger](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48379999/358034180/-1825595171?sourceid=1071963&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYWIxZjQ2MC1iYjBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=L-2gCoww1lrzjHQa2dLD5V37zy9ttS_GVRPlkFSryPU=&emci=34e82abf-af0d-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=0ab1f460-bb0d-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=43402276) endorsed Molly on July 14 and the [Addison Independent](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48380000/358034181/-754467183?sourceid=1071963&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDg5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYWIxZjQ2MC1iYjBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=L-2gCoww1lrzjHQa2dLD5V37zy9ttS_GVRPlkFSryPU=&emci=34e82abf-af0d-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=0ab1f460-bb0d-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=43402276) body:

---
| | | Friends,

In 2015, the Kansas legislature gave authority to the Secretary of State to prosecute election fraud.

At the same time, the Attorney General had an established fraud unit of investigators and prosecutors in his office, as well as the Kansas Bureau of Investigation, to investigate and prosecute election fraud.

Our opponent has stated that he intends to use hundreds of thousands of dollars to duplicate state services and staffing already provided by the Attorney General and local county attorneys and to hire his own staff, rather than the experienced prosecutors already available, to pursue election fraud.

Kansans expect their elected officials to use tax dollars wisely and not add to bureaucracy by creating duplicative services between agencies. As your Secretary of State, I have been doing - and will continue - to do just that. That's the conservative Kansas way.

I humbly ask for your vote on August 2.

All my best,
---
|

| Scott Schwab
Secretary of State

subject: Democrats want to defund police
body:
Still! And forever...
| | | |
---
---
|
# Democrats are forever tied to "Defund the Police"
---
|
---
---
| | |
---|---
|
In the summer of 2020, cities across the nation were in turmoil.
Rioters posing as protesters occupied large sections of cities. They destroyed property in cities from Seattle to Washington D.C. and kept business owners from their places of business.
The riots happened nationwide following the killing of George Floyd by Minneapolis police in May of that year. Among many consequences, one of the worst was that many Democrat-controlled city governments cowed to this lawlessness by committing to "Defund the Police." There was no clear definition of what actions that phrase entailed, but in some cases, it meant entirely eliminating some police departments.
| | |
---|---
|
These efforts were based entirely on emotional pleas, but that did not stop Vice-President Kamala Harris and Democratic members of Congress from echoing them. While the Vice-President did not fully support the effort, the coded language she used came very close. "[We do have to reimagine what public safety looks like. And here's the thing. It is status quo thinking to believe that putting more police on the streets creates more safety. That's wrong. It's just wrong](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001xSktBP4QldgM8arAHzldY0yncb3Lm9zclHjrdUYuLPc7WK3esdCTubgHU9Vvd8eXqNr5l6F4vTSrs4v98_SwqcsT6ho_9T5Wxhlkmr42LpWVwOcxsAJhWlXbF1uDIzRnXdbxP9vHDlAN6N1EpMkSf_tzk9KliqAr_nN4GR9KLld6Olh5ikteeO6Ts78fmNQegiGRcSzYg7Y=&c=zvQs_SVmXhJ_i4Q0X5uhto8H9iahV_ssTkDDy3YNXHi5Ysq2V_S9hA==&ch=LXBiTYhhsxTAhF7kSPr3v3Wrc--2JcEibJBFv8Egb79YBzLcSQdjbQ==)," Harris said.
Now many of the politicians--all of them Democrats--who supported some form of defunding are having to [backtrack on their wildly wrong-headed, radical positions](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001xSktBP4QldgM8arAHzldY0yncb3Lm9zclHjrdUYuLPc7WK3esdCTubgHU9Vvd8eXVx9ampmqzgUh2h_EfxtCgGyAxpCdTwInuTlEQ7c8rP7Z5F7us4t4fFelrRmzXB1YLcagN8jjrm2051J65mCD_SeMOi-OR91N845FClmVGIT3SCMi0XhC9jWfFLzwGZX4cD8DZmNbSM8TCctYtDDlo_ZmRIbHULMm6SMXHyHLbBs=&c=zvQs_SVmXhJ_i4Q0X5uhto8H9iahV_ssTkDDy3YNXHi5Ysq2V_S9hA==&ch=LXBiTYhhsxTAhF7kSPr3v3Wrc--2JcEibJBFv8Egb79YBzLcSQdjbQ==). This is largely because they are currently running for office and must run away from a position that voters nationwide do not want. What played well in 2020 is no longer in vogue in 2022.

| | | Hi Friend, [**National press**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/1XQbiUZqIgkFRQxQopJGKV3am-aTMJUNB4BSiL-LIIgJh3bkGMkIFE7n-I543KjrjDuiJZa1grLcX631DjVrcDCUgpjB9Lowe2jxgGHXReNHzduaGCmNT34Z5Nd5Cs14LLNVfFXflytuKfx-s1QHGMceixh1HR-3vXxGCCWWdWe5_NeBjbwvC6n9E5vV0H-SlLaD09L1MnezFZF3qnezEsaZBdr4GpzI4J7cFHfFTMveWnVJk-H6fKNwyvz2QsOi8JC_K0sOmpHaMEjB1dVT-DarU0z2M5AwBWYyPCiLgGx6AefYPGLnptsCZe_qGnNvN7aZIC3VSabc_u8n-VxEuEDJHp7iFS5L9s5e30taRNvrZcNaVlozlBLmIF5aK_CNioBTX149mqTBTfzNWTsA_Opf20UAlNjO_RztusrGHTA/3o3/VuNVh_62RcuqnR4_H6rE_Q/h0/46ltVUpRjA0RBRg4633LFZfyxyCMi1AUbNTJEWqXqaQ)**just broke yesterday about****how the Rhode Island Democratic establishment is backing a candidate in blackface over a progressive, Black woman – Jennifer Rourke.** It’s a shocking story. We’d encourage you to give it a read when you get a moment.
# [Read the article](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/1XQbiUZqIgkFRQxQopJGKV3am-aTMJUNB4BSiL-LIIgJh3bkGMkIFE7n-I543KjrjDuiJZa1grLcX631DjVrcBNDKv7yzUQ7cCsSIhqtkxJCj_n6vjSTw0TDSbzEX4_qZUp8eDiyxNKEnho3IWLg8AOqd04TyJn8gT52Cv5zGUguzr4LgWkEX2ftgaRIums-dr8qA6HuYx-sTaOPkTzOVkwOn3_AdLwZNZO_nDP2m8DQSrl8vxPkk6LYAvJyvCEDFFwAseIV0wVGpv8KINyLLf4ZrTB-7bJVufDmhdvsUEPbXbxCv6rjN8ZwPNVQNIcbq48MGVQ5fB5X1F5JjthozY85ugBAeUM9VUAB2nuey3DiXq5WCEXy79IaG-3OeR-34908Y8QKUY9wbPausEeqs63488RjlTsm5yOU7qiZHD4/3o3/VuNVh_62RcuqnR4_H6rE_Q/h1/2Fakr65QqkM5iFlqGBiAHw0HPebUgT2NJM1pBA0_KCg)
As you may remember, Jennifer is a co-chair of the [RI Political Cooperative](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/ZsYp6Jc2ATNP3MkVzvte6LTreagzDM0qD7pzarEMOlQ104hdM2NqR-Dz-6qpgRjuY_-mL-mefrdgLbLajqTq3-EplxaJ18t46S53GsEr4CfccmWdKcjdr5Le-qdDXPI1dmZI2n_fIHgZLOID-NMOSCSnrxlD09zBirKG_fK1P42q4UHbfaJKL36QAMbpNNKhOJj9-fGVIJhJh3aaBWTzZzGOrp5sQ1yUP86cAQb8g8hFOskaqQJKgESKvhxZiOLSCYn_P2fl-FzVkEWkncqL1Om19xRfS5FTAqdxTbX7z62vGNQNt3I6P6KF9wYUXbLrc61M6xiFUkxzw6UyzCjTsV33-v0yTvAjYFxmYXX4vfKx1hpsDc_zZdY5FHgULkO3_0Rw2Hf9eNXvhqtStZyjkQ/3o3/VuNVh_62RcuqnR4_H6rE_Q/h2/qRhgx1cW6cMbfA-zwdYc1C1OdB8nUxzuNi1umjgGZp0) along with Matt and a candidate for state Senate running with him and Cynthia. At a _Roe v. Wade_ rally a few weeks ago she was punched in the face by her Republican opponent, who promptly dropped out of the race along with the conservative (anti-Roe, pro-NRA) 27-year Democratic incumbent she was challenging. But here’s the latest from Aída Chávez: “Rourke is now facing a challenge from Michael Carreiro, who wore blackface and appears to be a fan of Tucker Carlson. **State Democratic party leaders haven’t just refused to support Rourke over Carreiro — they actually went out of their way to help Carreiro get on the ballot, collecting signatures on his behalf after it was revealed he wore blackface.”** This appalling revelation makes it crystal clear that the Democratic establishment will do almost anything – including backing a candidate in blackface – to protect their own power. Chávez goes on to point out that “the Rhode Island Democratic Party’s unwillingness to support Rourke, and role in propping up Carreiro’s run for office, is part of a broader pattern of establishment Democrats opposing progressive and working-class candidates across the country.” That’s why Matt and Jennifer founded the RI Political Cooperative with State Senator Jeanine Calkin – to break down the barriers to progressive, multi-racial, and working class candidates running for office, and winning. As people all across the country continue to learn what’s happening here in Rhode Island, our momentum is growing. **Can you help us keep it up by forwarding this email to 3 friends who should know about this story or by tweeting the article?** Team Matt and Cynthia

But that’s exactly why he’s in a tough race right now.** Some people with a whole lot of money have decided they don’t want an effective progressive like Andy Levin to stay in office. So he’s getting outspent more than two-to-one. Andy Levin’s grassroots team is smart and scrappy — they’re doubling down on person-to-person organizing to make up for the outside money dumped against them. We have to fight back because Republican billionaires, corporate PACs, and right-wing dark money groups have dumped millions of dollars into this race to try to defeat Andy Levin. Pure and simple, we can’t let them win.
If we let them decide the Democratic nominee here, that isn’t just dangerous for this district — it’s dangerous for our democracy. We have to say our democracy is not for sale. And we have to reelect Andy Levin — a progressive champion who makes us proud.
You know, Andy Levin isn’t the type of politician who hangs back, waits, and carefully chooses just which bills he’ll put his name on. I trust Andy Levin because he is a leader who fights from the heart — not by making careful calculations, but by fighting with courage. I trust Andy Levin because he gets in fights all the way — not because big donors like it, not because it will avoid political controversy, but because they are righteous fights.
And we’ve got plenty of righteous fights on our hands in Washington. So next January, when I’m in that foxhole to tackle the climate crisis, or codify Roe v. Wade into federal law, or level the playing field for more workers to be able to form unions, **I want to be able to look over and see Andy Levin in that foxhole with me.**
But that’s only possible if we get him across the finish line in Tuesday’s primary election.
[_**If you’re able to, please make a donation right now to help Andy Levin fight back against all the outside spending — and help keep his strong progressive voice in Washington, where he’ll keep delivering results.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48384674/358051910/2045083091?refcode=em_20220727_f_s_ew_B&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTM3OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDkxYTllNC1jMzBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OTB2zA8KcqMLkik7fWFwZ0KkznSl34wx9v2a2nzQNtc=)

clean_body: He is the true progressive in this race, and that’s why he’s under attack. | | | | | Peter, I went to Michigan this past weekend to campaign with Andy Levin because it is powerfully important that we keep him in Congress. I trust Andy Levin to fight for abortion rights, climate action, and a government that works for working people, not just the rich and powerful. He is the true progressive in Tuesday’s Democratic primary for Michigan’s new 11th District. But that’s exactly why he’s in a tough race right now. Some people with a whole lot of money have decided they don’t want an effective progressive like Andy Levin to stay in office. So he’s getting outspent more than two-to-one. Andy Levin’s grassroots team is smart and scrappy — they’re doubling down on person-to-person organizing to make up for the outside money dumped against them. And when people hear what Andy Levin is fighting for, they hop right on board. But this team needs more resources to execute their plan for the final days of this election, so I have to ask: = | If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | = = = = = = We have to fight back because Republican billionaires, corporate PACs, and right-wing dark money groups have dumped millions of dollars into this race to try to defeat Andy Levin. We have to say our democracy is not for sale. And we have to reelect Andy Levin — a progressive champion who makes us proud. You know, Andy Levin isn’t the type of politician who hangs back, waits, and carefully chooses just which bills he’ll put his name on. I trust Andy Levin because he is a leader who fights from the heart — not by making careful calculations, but by fighting with courage. I trust Andy Levin because he gets in fights all the way — not because big donors like it, not because it will avoid political controversy, but because they are righteous fights. And we’ve got plenty of righteous fights on our hands in Washington. So next January, when I’m in that foxhole to tackle the climate crisis, or codify Roe v. Every American has a right to work...Every business has a right to operate.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zpa1ouluf9772h8rr9bo2u2jbikgmqi44qadn9b0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sjim0p70s9h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpqcdtjmpqj4srk65qb6t9j6toj79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onhc3gmct1gmqp68p33c2omcdbje9qm7dhh6lrr0t35capj6djgm9jm8sbn69gb0puie1p64pjgm9j71p5jcdg74c36eaqbbc30etg6ct70m9j61o5lcdge1d9h66qj3dbi4no)

Friend,
I'm truly grateful for staunch allies like you.
_**It wouldn 't be right to go another day without expressing my gratitude for your unwavering support of my re-election campaign.**_
As Election Day nears, I'm taking some time to think back over the events that unfolded during my first term as Governor.
Do you remember Biden's Democrat allies in the legacy media running to cover for Dr. Fauci by supporting unscientific lockdowns and the harmful masking of our children?
Or the Biden administration blatantly and disgracefully colluding with Big Tech to silence free speech and cancel all dissent during the pandemic?
_Fortunately, they were not the only ones with access to COVID data ..._
As Governor of Florida, I reached out to and spoke with some of the best scientists and doctors in the world at Harvard, Stanford, and Oxford to assess the necessity of the Left's destructive lockdown policies.
**The data showed the Left 's draconian policies were failures, and I kept Florida open. And I'm glad I did.**
**Every American has a right to work.**
**Every business has a right to operate.**
That's why I stepped in and stopped local governments from restricting people from working or operating a business. [_**Do you support my decision to keep Florida open? Stand with me now. >>>**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zhclcdfa9a8e47lga86b4n45jivac8tqln4sj658_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sjim0p70s9h2bs)
I even issued pardons for those who were threatened by local governments with jail and ridiculous fines for operating during the pandemic.
I put my entire political career on the line to Keep Florida Free. _**I fought back.**_
It showed you exactly the kind of leader I am. I don't cower with fear about what the media may say -- _I just lead_.
In 2019, when I was inaugurated as Florida's 46th Governor, I didn't let the grass grow under my feet before turning the Tallahassee establishment upside down.
I immediately fulfilled several of my key campaign promises to Floridians, including:
✅ Changing the Florida Supreme Court for a generation by appointing three rock-solid conservative justices.
✅ Signing the largest expansion of school choice in the nation, giving parents greater freedom to choose the education that best meets their child's needs.
✅ Restoring election integrity by holding election officials accountable by accepting the resignation of Broward County Supervisor of Elections Brenda Snipes from public office, as well as suspending Palm Beach County Election Supervisor Susan Bucher.
✅ Suspending Broward County Sheriff Scott Israel for his failure to protect the students at Marjorie Stoneman Douglas High School during the massacre at Parkland in 2018.
Of course, making these moves during my first few days in office was just a preview of what I set out to accomplish.
**Over my first three years, I 've continued to steer Florida to a strong, safe, prosperous future with liberty as my guide and the Constitutions as my north star.**
[_**Do you think Florida is headed in the right direction? Rush in any amount now to keep our accomplishments going for another four years!**_](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zg43fshq8a8o3jlj0ibrvbicik9g5kq45139he2g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sjim0p70s9h2bs)
I refuse to simply kick the can down the road or seek out the path of least resistance when it comes to doing the right thing.
I certainly don't set my priorities according to what is preferred by Silicon Valley's CEOs, Big Tech's shady algorithms, or the corrupt media's agenda!
I refuse to bow to pressure from the Biden administration, kiss the ring of power-hungry government bureaucrats like Fauci, or follow orders from woke corporations who want to dictate to us how to live and what to think.

Dear #VALUE!,

At the Mississippi Center for Public Policy, we are focused on helping to make Mississippi a better place and defending the ideals that make our country, and our state, so unique. At any time of the year, you can find us advocating in the legislature, the executive branch, the courts, and the public square to protect the constitutional ideals of liberty and justice for all and to foster freedom and prosperity in our state. We do it all because we are committed to Mississippi and to you. That’s why we are incredibly excited that the State Policy Network has selected us as a finalist for **two national awards** in recognition of our work over the past year. First, we have been selected along with our friends at Empower Mississippi as finalists for a joint [Outstanding Policy Achievement Award](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=2e330e8242&e=5703353baa) for our advocacy in support of the Mississippi Tax Freedom Act of 2022, which secured the largest tax cut in the state’s history.

Second, the Mississippi Center for Public Policy has **also** been selected as a finalist for a [Communications Excellence Award](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=3e3b189fe5&e=5703353baa) in recognition of our efforts to keep all of you informed about the important policy issues affecting Mississippi.

**Most importantly: your vote counts!** If you support our work then please take a second to click here and vote for the Mississippi Center for Public Policy!

subject: Your 2022 Second Amendment Survey
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWtNQxuhpN

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWtNQxuhpN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Friend of the Constitution,

The far Left in America is attempting to
rewrite our nation's history and undermine our Constitution-with
a special emphasis on eliminating the Second Amendment.

Today, you're receiving Hillsdale College's
Second Amendment Survey because you're someone who understands
that education is essential to the defense of liberty.

We are reaching and teaching millions of
Americans about the importance of liberty, and we are doing this
without accepting even ONE PENNY of government funding.

Could you take a few minutes to complete our
Second Amendment Survey using the secure link below?

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

Your timely survey answers will help us reach
and teach millions of our fellow citizens in the coming year
about the importance of liberty-which includes the rights
protected by the Second Amendment.

There is no question that one of the Left's
most powerful tools in its ongoing effort to undermine our
liberty is ignorance.

Here at Hillsdale, we have been pursuing
truth and defending liberty since the College was founded in
1844.

Today our educational outreach efforts
include programs on a variety of topics essential to liberty,
such as the Second Amendment.

As constitutional scholar Edward J. Erler
observed in Imprimis, our digest of liberty that reaches millions
of Americans: "The Second Amendment is an expression of first
principles."

This means the Second Amendment is essential
for the preservation of freedom. If we are denied the means of
defending our freedom, we will eventually lose our freedom.

This kind of thinking is foreign to most
college and university campuses today, where "safe spaces" are
now commonplace, and shooting clubs are nearly extinct. Here's an
example…

Not long ago, the University of Virginia
canceled its traditional 21-gun salute on Veterans Day.

Why?

The administration was concerned that firing
guns in honor of those who served their country and did their
part to defend our freedom would cause "panic" among the student
body.

Unfortunately, there are many more such
examples I could cite to illustrate the disastrous effects of the
ongoing decline in civics education in America.

But instead of just TALKING, it's more
important to DO something about it.

That's why we have been working to expand our
educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

And this work continues today.

That's why I would like your answers to our
brief Second Amendment Survey. You can complete the survey today
at this secure link:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

We believe that an educated citizenry is
essential for the preservation of our liberty. As Ronald Reagan
said, "Freedom is never more than one generation away from
extinction."

Do you agree? I hope so.

This is why we reach and teach millions of
Americans about the principles of liberty and the Constitution.
It's also why we need your help today.

As I mentioned, Hillsdale refuses to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans. This frees us from
much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

Our independence from the government means
that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of
citizens like you, who understand the importance of education to
liberty.

It also means your gift really matters.

Today, you have a great opportunity to help
preserve liberty-including the Second Amendment-for future
generations.

After completing your Second Amendment
Survey, please join me in the cause of liberty with your generous
tax-deductible gift today.

And, when you give a $100 gift or more, we'll
send you a special, limited-edition Hillsdale College hat as our
thank you.

This hat commemorates our partnership with
USA Shooting, the organization dedicated to preparing the best
American shooters to represent our country in the Olympics and
Paralympics. But hurry-supplies are limited!

Thank you for your time and attention. I look
forward to receiving your completed Second Amendment Survey.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

P.S. Our Constitution-including the Second
Amendment-is under attack today. Do you agree? Then please take
our Second Amendment Survey at the secure link below. It will
only take a few minutes, and your answers will help to preserve
liberty for future generations. Thank you!

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

body:
Please give me a moment to explain.
#
Hi, Derek -- It’s Lucas Kunce.
I know you probably get a lot of emails. **But please give me a moment to explain why I’m running for Missouri’s open U.S. Senate seat, just like John Fetterman is running for Pennsylvania’s open Senate seat.**
As a kid from a working-class neighborhood right in the middle of Missouri, I never expected to run for office.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220727-1?refcode=em20220727-6657&refcode2=6657_434096_oXD3_x&akid=6657%2E434096%2EoXD3_x)
Like so many others, my family struggled to make ends meet — and when my little sister was born with a heart condition, we relied on the generosity of our neighbors to make it. They helped me go to college, and after that, I joined the Marines to honor everything they gave to me.
But when I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, I found a community that had been picked for parts — the corner store where my mom floated a check boarded up and my first family house bulldozed to the ground. Here’s all that’s left of it:
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220727-1?refcode=em20220727-6657&refcode2=6657_434096_oXD3_x&akid=6657%2E434096%2EoXD3_x)
While my buddies and I risked our lives building up towns like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat, career politicians, and the corporate elites backing them, let our country waste away.
Even now, after spending 20 years and $6.4 trillion on pointless forever wars, defense contractors, and nation-building abroad, they can’t figure out how to invest a fraction of that amount back into America.
**Just like my friend John Fetterman, I believe that everyday Americans should be calling the shots in this country.[_So today, I’m asking for your support to make it happen._](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220727-1?refcode=em20220727-6657&refcode2=6657_434096_oXD3_x&akid=6657%2E434096%2EoXD3_x)**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220727-1?refcode=em20220727-6657&refcode2=6657_434096_oXD3_x&akid=6657%2E434096%2EoXD3_x)
**If you’re ready to take back power from the giant corporations and corrupt, career politicians who’ve stripped states like Missouri and Pennsylvania for parts, I need you on our team.**
**[_Can you chip in $5 so we’ll have the resources we need to get our message in front of voters and flip this U.S. Senate seat? Your donation will be split between my campaign and John’s campaign before the July 31 midnight deadline. Neither of us takes any money from corporate PACs, so I mean it when I say anything makes a big impact._](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220727-1?refcode=em20220727-6657&refcode2=6657_434096_oXD3_x&akid=6657%2E434096%2EoXD3_x)**

Thank you so much for all your support,
Lucas Kunce
