name: Wes Moore
subject: Humbly asking for your support in Maryland
body:
Wes Moore is running to build a Maryland that works for everyone. Will you split a donation between his campaign and CommonGood today so he can defeat Trump-backed extremist Dan Cox? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_moore?refcode=20220727_CGVA_Moore]
Derek,
It’s now official.
I am proud to report – with humility and pride – that I am the Democratic nominee to be Maryland’s next Governor.
If you can help us kick off this general election campaign by splitting a contribution between my campaign and CommonGood, chip in here, and together, we’re going to get this done. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_moore?refcode=20220727_CGVA_Moore]
When you consider my opponent, the Republican nominee Dan Cox, the stakes have quite literally never been higher.
Marylanders will face a very clear choice this November.
A choice between unity and division. A choice between a future built on hope and optimism vs. the cynical politics of conspiracy theories and fear. A choice between the values we embrace as Marylanders and Donald Trump’s divisive and dangerous MAGA movement.
When I led soldiers in combat in Afghanistan as a Captain in the U.S. Army, we lived by a principle: leave no one behind.
This principle is not a slogan. It’s a value that drives this campaign.
It’s a value that will guide me as Governor of Maryland.
Right now, too many Marylanders are being left behind. Unable to fill the gas tank or keep up with monthly bills. Feeling unsafe in their own communities, or with their children trapped in schools that are not preparing their children for the jobs of today or tomorrow.
That all must change.
We get there with new ideas, and a new spirit of togetherness – working across party lines and regional lines, through civility and collaboration.
That’s an approach my opponent, Dan Cox, doesn’t believe in.
Cox has pledged his unwavering allegiance to Donald Trump. Cox personally organized buses of insurrectionists to the U.S. Capitol on January 6. He spread Trump’s lies about the 2020 election and fought to have it overturned. He traffics in conspiracy theories. He tried to impeach Governor Hogan. Cox represents the most extreme fringe of American politics.
Simply put, Dan Cox is so far outside the mainstream that I believe he’d be dangerous in the Governor's office.
And it’s not just about Donald Trump – abortion access is on the ballot. Public school funding is on the ballot. A $15 minimum wage is on the ballot. The future of our environment is on the ballot.
I believe Maryland is the best state in America to live and raise a family, but to fulfill our potential, we must make sure all Marylanders have that opportunity at success.
So that’s what’s at stake this November.
We’ve got work to do, and aren’t taking our opponent lightly for even a minute.
We’ve got more voters to talk to about our message, and our campaign is going to have to grow. If you can help us kick off this general election campaign with a contribution, chip in here, and together, we’re going to get this done. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_moore?refcode=20220727_CGVA_Moore]
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_moore?refcode=20220727_CGVA_Moore&amount=25]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_moore?refcode=20220727_CGVA_Moore&amount=35]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_moore?refcode=20220727_CGVA_Moore&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_moore?refcode=20220727_CGVA_Moore&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_moore?refcode=20220727_CGVA_Moore&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_moore?refcode=20220727_CGVA_Moore]
From the bottom of my heart, on behalf of my family and my amazing running mate, Delegate Aruna Miller, I thank you for the opportunity to serve.
Onward to victory,
Wes

Countdown to the primary!
Peter, it's almost that time again. Washington's primary is in less than one week!

This people-powered team has pulled through for my campaign time and time again, but with so much at stake in the midterms, we can't slow down the fight for our democracy. I know it's been said a million times before, but there could not be more on the line this election year.

We are facing unprecedented attacks on our democracy, reproductive freedom, and LGBTQ+ rights. And the far-right Supreme Court has made it clear they're not going to stop state legislatures from enacting draconian and un-democratic restrictions on our civil rights. It's up to Congress to codify our fundamental rights to equality and freedom.

I proudly voted for a bill that will recognize same-sex marriage at the federal level and legislation that will enshrine _Roe v. Wade_ into federal law. I also helped forward the Ensuring Access to Abortion Act to protect a patient's right to travel for legal abortions.

As a mother to two great kids, affordable child care was always top of mind when they were young and my husband and I needed to work. Families across the district are still struggling with rising prices at the pump, in the grocery store, with healthcare and even school supplies... and child care is no different. The Build Back Better initiative introduced by President Biden originally included $400 billion of new funding that would go toward supporting families who needed a little extra financial support to care for their children. However, child care now finds itself out of the Reconciliation Bill discussion altogether. This is both unimaginable and short-sighted. In Westchester and the Bronx, child care is the biggest bill in the household and we can’t create a system that supports safe, quality child care without federal investment. clean_body: | | | | | OUR CHILDREN’S CARE SHOULD BE A PRIORITY | As a mother to two great kids, affordable child care was always top of mind when they were young and my husband and I needed to work. Families across the district are still struggling with rising prices at the pump, in the grocery store, with healthcare and even school supplies... and child care is no different. The Build Back Better initiative introduced by President Biden originally included $400 billion of new funding that would go toward supporting families who needed a little extra financial support to care for their children. However, child care now finds itself out of the Reconciliation Bill discussion altogether. This is both unimaginable and short-sighted. In Westchester and the Bronx, child care is the biggest bill in the household and we can’t create a system that supports safe, quality child care without federal investment. = That’s why as your congresswoman, I will fight hard to bring funding child care services into the mainstream. Prioritizing child care with at least $200 billion of new funding, as suggested by Senators Murray and Kaine, to support our working parents, their children, and our economic future. = ******************************************************************************************Learn more by visiting Catherine’s website, or follow her on , , or . | Peter-
It's happening across the country - Pelosi's campaign machine is spending millions of dollars to influence elections. But I'm not talking about general elections where it's Democrats vs Republicans. I'm talking about our Republican primary elections. That's right. The Democrats' latest tactic is to hit swing districts with television spots that boost fringe, far-right candidates who have virtually no chance of winning in the general election.

| [ ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001yjR8owgxYXYkIYtPhhlA_9vrfJHfMMz9TVCfoDNynu22A5fctNtQKg_p4pbQWdZO433uiQYwnS5Bqz6VaHnT3WUHysfWEz8zYhBktjlcwBGyXNxl0cgc7ZFyAdqN228OZjoT2AFEUAxa5IbTfXg85QZGPY1k6Wpuo_Gqo5UwDOaOiL7e9kswnajKAUuV4PWMJuBexoYZY8JuuNMytPI8RhvZFXUqkc_5ZamhMEuewqNw-RN-EQfI5407k6Us4j9V1-4V16RdnnY=&c=ahvBMJZT3HCZsvheYxUQGmEc9f66fHD0UWG_jw7RIAzvwU-DMQD8zA==&ch=fJpYjv-U_M3uwNEqUWvAjzI4UuQorWfqXo0yUClUDGAfnj0gn0AGqA==)

| The most recent example is their attempts to primary GOP Congressman Peter Meijer in Michigan's 3rd Congressional district. He's a West Point graduate and Iraq war veteran. He's a commonsense conservative who represents a district that was redistricted into a seat where Democrats hold the advantage... it's currently a D+3 seat and Democrats see it as one of their best pick-up opportunities in the country. Meijer is likely the only Republican who can hold onto this seat, and his main opponent, John Gibbs, will likely lose it if he wins the Republican primary.
---
| That's exactly why Pelosi's Democrat Congressional Campaign Committee - the DCCC - is spending $425,000 on television ads this week to boost John Gibbs. The ads paint Gibbs as "too conservative" for Michigan and Trump's "handpicked candidate." That plays well in a Republican primary - and if this were a red district it would play well in the general election too.
But this fight is in a true swing district. Recent polling showed the Democrat challenger beating Gibbs by 10 points if he were the Republican nominee in November. You can see why the DCCC is so committed to getting rid of commonsense conservative Peter Meijer. He is the only chance we've got to keep this swing district in Republican hands. If you want to support Peter and keep Michigan-03 red, [you can donate to his campaign here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001yjR8owgxYXYkIYtPhhlA_9vrfJHfMMz9TVCfoDNynu22A5fctNtQKg_p4pbQWdZO6GwuO1iWrdABolnXzENO4fWGpKCJRlSp_Y0gFmOceJ_PvfQU7V2GUrpAXMJ-SxvjfIyIuqKKv4mn3C7j92-_8AYGoi5QFRCDXuGBxG-laIvJnMRuZUjL0sarTtMXB38jdojWZ-hW69f4Exdnh_O5lhpeeWhXX8ippTxh_SVjEwfl-Px3K828ujLOvferplizURtHcAiLKgweid8JQ9pVC--Kl0hKxbKn5V1TPgIsmr3AkyaoQJpL3YjwDIyqGRpiRvkgVA-yKItWvGNe2N7F3qbcbco480yG-33jgEDgFKU=&c=ahvBMJZT3HCZsvheYxUQGmEc9f66fHD0UWG_jw7RIAzvwU-DMQD8zA==&ch=fJpYjv-U_M3uwNEqUWvAjzI4UuQorWfqXo0yUClUDGAfnj0gn0AGqA==). His primary is Tuesday, August 2nd and he needs all the support you can afford to give him.
Democrats repeated this political trick in other races too. It happened in the [Colorado](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001yjR8owgxYXYkIYtPhhlA_9vrfJHfMMz9TVCfoDNynu22A5fctNtQKg_p4pbQWdZOkOKA19idUrjrEFISzUlSNN1ot_pmBTnC9shyXw-Kf4IIlmtRIqUs_3MfZFWvrZCYMzwsugpvaTxoS9FT-tT8E1b7cABKFO8vv9HQ8KBTa0mA0o6GnKKenXKf1zezuRvaDFEQ0bqW1yuVLp4scTMY4sm3wO0ckymD&c=ahvBMJZT3HCZsvheYxUQGmEc9f66fHD0UWG_jw7RIAzvwU-DMQD8zA==&ch=fJpYjv-U_M3uwNEqUWvAjzI4UuQorWfqXo0yUClUDGAfnj0gn0AGqA==) GOP U.S. Senate primary race last month, where Democrats spent over $5 million on television, digital, and direct mail to elevate far-right Republican state senator Ron Hanks. Hanks raised a little more than $124,000, which is nothing in a U.S. Senate race, and he was the only Republican in the Colorado State Legislature to vote against criminalizing a sexual relationship between 18-year old students and teachers. Hanks ended up losing the primary to the actual front runner, Republican businessman Joe O'Dea, but not before Democrats tried desperately to help Hanks win. Democrat dark money groups relentlessly lied about Joe in mailers to Republican households - calling Joe "anti-gun" when the truth is he was the only candidate in the race endorsed by the NRA.
And over the past few months the Democrats used the same playbook in the GOP governors' primaries for [Colorado](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001yjR8owgxYXYkIYtPhhlA_9vrfJHfMMz9TVCfoDNynu22A5fctNtQKg_p4pbQWdZOR3JG01yGrKp3N_VluahLGohEaN28jrP66G7vrzHSkQVqaGhNcUFOgULtIoDo4lYv2UoL-iXMLaPaiExaxjBjAoGCzuhh5Rlfb0T9Bx-CuCo_6L4FtCuw4tVHy2-oa8rpSXQ5Gto3iIc9VQ0l068PnAyo9FXWuvToPyAnG0J2V4o=&c=ahvBMJZT3HCZsvheYxUQGmEc9f66fHD0UWG_jw7RIAzvwU-DMQD8zA==&ch=fJpYjv-U_M3uwNEqUWvAjzI4UuQorWfqXo0yUClUDGAfnj0gn0AGqA==), [Illinois](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001yjR8owgxYXYkIYtPhhlA_9vrfJHfMMz9TVCfoDNynu22A5fctNtQKg_p4pbQWdZOnoLXcE_Eg59EYVzmxZMlYHXlSY9AJit5splUTXrQBsd_u3OvJRFuf8IIwMvZ8RVApZ3WvVT_Eoqwco1DOsHSNeLClFhCdOkxjOGiw14aglW1BwDIs2GBevR2MDy5_PJaC3MCin1C_ah5L3h-2S5NTDwcjvsdpuWVBRWsM0TEroY=&c=ahvBMJZT3HCZsvheYxUQGmEc9f66fHD0UWG_jw7RIAzvwU-DMQD8zA==&ch=fJpYjv-U_M3uwNEqUWvAjzI4UuQorWfqXo0yUClUDGAfnj0gn0AGqA==), and [Pennsylvania](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001yjR8owgxYXYkIYtPhhlA_9vrfJHfMMz9TVCfoDNynu22A5fctNtQKg_p4pbQWdZOLGI0HA2U-E8-52WzDPWzjWv2V3z1zzVLObhplSAo2vJkxXtYpAlfLS5wGZY-FP0pZsvI4IPilLhWuF04nSJCksN4Mtp_eM7x7NNw5jSG-vSOq-fyG48jl7HgRYe32FInkfTPKQskmivu1JLhk8BCLJWOyRp4aYQ9RlwEf1rgSBo=&c=ahvBMJZT3HCZsvheYxUQGmEc9f66fHD0UWG_jw7RIAzvwU-DMQD8zA==&ch=fJpYjv-U_M3uwNEqUWvAjzI4UuQorWfqXo0yUClUDGAfnj0gn0AGqA==). Far-right candidates - none of whom have a real shot at winning general elections in a swing state - are being propped up with millions of dollars in television ads by Democrat organizations.
More than $1.5 million was spent by the Democratic Governors Association to boost the weaker candidate in the GOP primary for Governor of Colorado - a man named Greg Lopez who had been arrested in 1993 for assaulting his pregnant wife. The frontrunner for the GOP governor nomination was University of Colorado Regent Heidi Ganahl. Heidi is currently the only statewide elected Republican in Colorado and she outraised Lopez 8 to 1. Heidi ultimately won the nomination, but it was closer than it should have been.
In Illinois, more than $32 million was spent by Democrats to boost the weaker candidate in the GOP primary for governor. The front runner in the GOP primary was the mayor of Aurora, Illinois, Mayor Richard Irvin. Irvin is a veteran, former prosecutor, and black conservative who emphasized fighting crime, cutting taxes, and cleaning up spending. Irvin would have made a formidable Republican candidate against far-left Governor Pritzker in November, and Democrats knew that, which is why they spent millions to help the far-right candidate in the GOP primary. Democrats succeeded when Irvin lost the GOP primary to state Senator Darren Bailey, who is unlikely to win the general election.
In the Pennsylvania GOP primary for governor, Democrats spent over $800,000 on ads to boost far-right state Senator Doug Mastriano. Mastriano won the primary, and now he's trailing in the polls against Democrat Attorney General Josh Shapiro.
We cannot let Democrats continue chipping away at what should be a strong, governing conservative majority in this country after the November election. I'm working hard to expose their dirty, manipulative tactics and stop good Republican voters from falling for it. There is way too much at stake.
If you care as passionately about stopping the Democrats' deceit as I do, please help me expose it. If you can afford to, please chip in any amount at [this link](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001yjR8owgxYXYkIYtPhhlA_9vrfJHfMMz9TVCfoDNynu22A5fctNtQKg_p4pbQWdZOlTAF5VYM1e2UR29iT7gy2fTECySW0XmHvzfzrXEYtBll8_lRSs3v-h5y2Jw1-yICtKAY9Z4wdWsYizbUP7UxUtv4FxmzrT-2oDFQLie87v4FAhGVlh_hUjEdujHQMBjFAwwtA_Hm8bI39XHorCmjuopox8l7D6ZxuHRtA7BYdVfbHiae3rmSUJSYAfpgduq_C9JcLBl1NLjW-CHmGzrH3nzVPIuhJmjmbooNok-zMyMDr1-ljJ4Q4paGL-429lyQNwz2sQdgI6_o3dIKogJXX4m2bIExPcKcJ1NgFIOfkCE2qqZIVjSnAQ==&c=ahvBMJZT3HCZsvheYxUQGmEc9f66fHD0UWG_jw7RIAzvwU-DMQD8zA==&ch=fJpYjv-U_M3uwNEqUWvAjzI4UuQorWfqXo0yUClUDGAfnj0gn0AGqA==) to help me share this message far and wide.
August is going to be a huge month for primaries across the country and our last chance to nominate good, commonsense conservatives in the swing districts that will make or break the Republican majority for the next two years. body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our presi
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zr8kv6t20dus05n76ei45l1qqi9ucgo95oqopar8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkir39tdkmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbq64tpim4qe4c9mcipm8tlhchq7fclje3ijcohncormacbjmdgmco3269g71c9n6v970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj666rjad70e8qmcc9gmdhmfc5lclp238h1e8he4933clge9pb5cdh66oh5u)
This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zb3nfndacosktsmqdqrr6lirv9q8dfcb0vehkjeo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sjimaor2cdh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z1mtvl6p5b3e5a8l0n03rn2vvjkm7082v2kjbu78_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sjimaor2cdh2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. | Hi Derek, Senator Bob Casey here.

I am personally reaching out today to tell you why I’m proud to endorse Chris Deluzio’s campaign to represent Pennsylvania’s 17th district in Congress. I hope you’ll consider **[chipping in a few dollars to make sure he can share his message far and wide](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48406088/358118310/-454070568?refcode=em_fr_2022.07.27_b1_sbc_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNTg1MDk1Yi1mMzBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OFZwmZ48y86T2luj7UmUPGMfQY2CiFLJWsMH-edxfrw=)** but, if you need some convincing, let me explain why I’m on Chris’s team.

**Above all, Chris knows what people in Pittsburgh and across our Commonwealth care about, and he’s ready to get to work.**

In Congress, Chris will fight to take on the corporate power that has killed small businesses and cost us good-paying jobs right here in Pennsylvania. He’s committed to protecting a woman’s right to choose, fighting for clean air and water, pushing back against cuts to Social Security so people can retire with dignity, and ensuring health care and prescription drugs don’t cost an arm and a leg.

**At this critical time in our nation’s history, that’s exactly the type of leader we need fighting for Pennsylvania’s working families.**

[**That’s why I’m endorsing Chris to keep PA-17 blue, but he needs our help. Governor Ron DeSantis has proven himself to be a champion of full transparency when it comes to education and keeping left-wing agendas out of the classroom. Sunshine is the best disinfectant, as the saying goes. To this end, Florida has enacted rigorous parental control measures aiming to protect children in public schools. From [outlawing Critical Race Theory](https://substack.com/redirect/b910018c-ba71-4f9b-a7da-96eaff52eef1?u=90501192) in K-12 classrooms, fighting back when the Biden administration [threatens](https://substack.com/redirect/f405ede5-df05-444a-8514-7ea6b2e87948?u=90501192) to take away school lunch program funding, and ensuring gender studies aren't taught to elementary students, DeSantis is one of the most courageous and effective politicians in America right now.
As of July 1st, HB 1557-The "Parental Rights in Education" is active law. The bill was quickly caricatured by the left and the mainstream media as the "[Don't Say Gay](https://substack.com/redirect/8ad02949-01d3-4ca8-a24f-73346072437c?u=90501192)" bill as if this has anything to do with it--spoiler: it doesn't. The bill protects children and focuses on providing transparent information to all stakeholders - students, parents, teachers, administrators, and policymakers. Effectively empowering them with data to facilitate continuous improvement, direct resources where they are needed most and make informed choices that are best for their family, school, and community. Recall, parents in Florida recently filed a lawsuit against a school and administrators for [having secret meetings with their gender-confused child](https://substack.com/redirect/c9d5a555-865a-4659-be9c-1c3c4f0517db?u=90501192) which led to two suicide attempts.
Public schools, largely controlled by teachers unions, need parents willing to step up and fight for their child's education. It is time to put the power of education freedom into the hands of parents and families through school board elections. We have been hard at work endorsing candidates across the state of Florida who will be champions of parental rights and pledge to support robust education, not indoctrination.

body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.

|
---
| | | Friend,

I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I’ve been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I’d take a second to walk you through why I’m running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=99de291cac0d43ee9aac6e0677286953&_e=tEQJ3XgGN98R5VirH2iuevTjyJQJX0PBvEa14zf12uslbjEe_zu4_QqoEFI2JAzjNewN8eqfM1I2V12PaqbCJaa1-Z10H1TmxdYKqqgsUtH7mbEqC2UPGp5TiorMntwy9LaNx22FArNOW3IV4WiYy7RTXwHKjSWkKlcL4w1YeBGglPyFpun-EGq50rFgdC7yLEvblLg1Yed9IIiBROH2ULbChLtad-uWL1jRW1sj2rnefRbVg0Kx9Jem3oE_1wpuCiBX2Q5Rldf2zoqcsARTKXnvyYX2a8JJtws2p401weyl0Ima40fjXIpRkczQMiP6G8Zs-_10UWtp0lSXRvZMfwjDx4_gAw2esyUyWQQSz9WrFpFcqOfTSEg-H-KJuV8ZXjSQUBL5JnU564nE-uCJS4HzRbalDJIgDYcz9FbNk4uTDIuWHEpCJSl4-fVFlY1- "2")
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=99de291cac0d43ee9aac6e0677286953&_e=tEQJ3XgGN98R5VirH2iuevTjyJQJX0PBvEa14zf12uslbjEe_zu4_QqoEFI2JAzjNewN8eqfM1I2V12PaqbCJaa1-Z10H1TmxdYKqqgsUtH7mbEqC2UPGp5TiorMntwy9LaNx22FArNOW3IV4WiYy7RTXwHKjSWkKlcL4w1YeBGglPyFpun-EGq50rFgdC7yLEvblLg1Yed9IIiBROH2ULbChLtad-uWL1jRW1sj2rnKnUSdydIU2dLz7dAt5o3A8rRqqzsXnbhXyOPdx0bsvt2WrX9HrRktcYR5emKydeTOLpjP8fRqwlTyxDp28V_nvW66mGf3tWr9uiTGuS9k8lIWS9JGKeOaruuS8D89vBFITF82IXztsQrqoXMw4ynOsSgs8hU7J123zmEAnuHdsIlIk8adbsVHWAuTX1ozGhTl2g2G7IOJ1Vq-fyPLMd-X "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=99de291cac0d43ee9aac6e0677286953&_e=tEQJ3XgGN98R5VirH2iuevTjyJQJX0PBvEa14zf12uslbjEe_zu4_QqoEFI2JAzjNewN8eqfM1I2V12PaqbCJaa1-Z10H1TmxdYKqqgsUtH7mbEqC2UPGp5TiorMntwy9LaNx22FArNOW3IV4WiYy7RTXwHKjSWkKlcL4w1YeBGglPyFpun-EGq50rFgdC7yLEvblLg1Yed9IIiBROH2ULbChLtad-uWL1jRW1sj2rlTE3Iw7XZNdm45w9YU6TV1uWzY7hN9qwr78hDUHHo8VBKGE5QTwnRuUvFHGjDQWr2lqqChgVMcOSezWLeNkWSJAcHwufZRLG4flkoeZUcQDq6HAbC97e2qPavhMNxd7EsBeMiVb8869KuyUVi_bzYsKxv83MB7u6aKMLXAOwjCwi5T7bM5Pew0eoKxjeLzKzFDBEPLUS1XRDOAxslMEExr "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden’s policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that’s exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I’m teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=99de291cac0d43ee9aac6e0677286953&_e=tEQJ3XgGN98R5VirH2iuevTjyJQJX0PBvEa14zf12uslbjEe_zu4_QqoEFI2JAzjNewN8eqfM1I2V12PaqbCJaa1-Z10H1TmxdYKqqgsUtH7mbEqC2UPGp5TiorMntwy9LaNx22FArNOW3IV4WiYy7RTXwHKjSWkKlcL4w1YeBGglPyFpun-EGq50rFgdC7yLEvblLg1Yed9IIiBROH2ULbChLtad-uWL1jRW1sj2rkYCCiRms_RKK9lwspVxr4cL5U4ng0Xm9bthSGFFWQOdGekde38Pt8-S1jXzPwVaKQ7q_BusfZmtL-n1yB6rE8be0mOK31CKz7hWxMOJFrEUWcOtYZivFAYzzPE85NdAGB9k1d143ZJCTP4hcg_bq7N6cM7dANzF7rGVaQAzkXXiJiSkQpJemd-LEII5VuTTNwPHo7riqtxWxqQ-OikleCS "4")
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn’t have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

In a few moments, we're going to ask you to chip in what you can to support Karen's historic campaign for Los Angeles Mayor. Research – You don’t know what you don’t know, you know? Mailing – When you receive a mailer from Karen, you can bet your donation helped pay for printing and postage! Food, snacks, and water – It’s not easy knocking on hundreds of doors on an empty stomach. Yard signs, bumper stickers, t-shirts – How else are people supposed to know Karen’s running? clean_body: | | | | Peter, All indicators are pointing to a close race between us and our Republican opponent Alek Skarlatos. We've always known that this would be a difficult seat to hold. On top of that, Alek has out-raised us so far this year, tapping into the network of MAGA donors he built up in his 2020 campaign. Now, national Republican groups are funneling even more cash into this district. They know what we know: this seat is key to which party will control the majority in Congress. = Peter, we don't have to tell you that there's a lot on the line this November. This district needs a leader who's going to stand up for our environment, reproductive rights, and working families. Val is that leader, and she has the track record to back it up. As a state representative, Val led the way to pass laws raising the minimum wage and establishing paid sick days for all Oregon workers. She expanded Oregon's Clean Fuels program, and helped pass legislation that made Oregon the first state in the nation to ban coal power. And as our Labor Commissioner, Val has fought for equal pay for equal work, and expanded Oregon's Family Leave Act during the pandemic to protect working parents when schools were shut down. Peter — This is a longer email than usual, so I hope you have a few minutes to read it today. It has now been a month since the U.S. Supreme Court dragged the country backward by overturning _Roe v. Wade_ , ripping reproductive health care away from millions of Americans. **In just a month, we have heard horrifying stories from across the country.** A 10-year-old rape victim was forced to travel to Ohio from Indiana to get an abortion, and a national anti-abortion group argued that the 10-year-old _should have been forced to give birth._ At least 13 states across the country have banned abortion, with more to follow in the weeks and months ahead. And, even in our state, Oregon Right to Life is _already_ working on a bill for the 2023 legislative session to ban abortions later in pregnancy. Abortion is health care. The attacks will not stop coming any time soon, and Governors are the last line of defense for reproductive rights. **I am not backing down.** **I’m proud to be the only candidate running for governor endorsed by Pro-Choice Oregon and Planned Parenthood PAC of Oregon.** My opponents cannot be trusted on this important issue. Former Senator Betsy Johnson is facing new criticism after the _Willamette Week_ resurfaced a video by the head of “Republicans for Betsy” stating that on the issue of abortion, Johnson is “virtually identical” to Oregon Right to Life-endorsed candidate Christine Drazan. Meanwhile, Republican candidate Christine Drazan is deeply out of touch with the majority of Oregonians on the issue of abortion. Drazan celebrated the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ , and told OPB that she would have vetoed the state’s landmark Reproductive Health Equity Act in 2017. **As your next Governor, I will unequivocally protect the right for anyone — regardless of where they live, their age, gender, race, income level, or the manner in which they became pregnant — to receive abortion care in Oregon.** [**We determine our future when we vote this November. clean_body: | Peter — This is a longer email than usual, so I hope you have a few minutes to read it today. It has now been a month since the U.S. Supreme Court dragged the country backward by overturning Roe v. Wade , ripping reproductive health care away from millions of Americans. In just a month, we have heard horrifying stories from across the country. A 10-year-old rape victim was forced to travel to Ohio from Indiana to get an abortion, and a national anti-abortion group argued that the 10-year-old should have been forced to give birth. At least 13 states across the country have banned abortion, with more to follow in the weeks and months ahead. And, even in our state, Oregon Right to Life is already working on a bill for the 2023 legislative session to ban abortions later in pregnancy. Abortion is health care. The attacks will not stop coming any time soon, and Governors are the last line of defense for reproductive rights. I am not backing down. I’m proud to be the only candidate running for governor endorsed by Pro-Choice Oregon and Planned Parenthood PAC of Oregon. My opponents cannot be trusted on this important issue. Former Senator Betsy Johnson is facing new criticism after the Willamette Week resurfaced a video by the head of “Republicans for Betsy” stating that on the issue of abortion, Johnson is “virtually identical” to Oregon Right to Life-endorsed candidate Christine Drazan. Meanwhile, Republican candidate Christine Drazan is deeply out of touch with the majority of Oregonians on the issue of abortion. Drazan celebrated the overturning of Roe v. Wade , and told OPB that she would have vetoed the state’s landmark Reproductive Health Equity Act in 2017. As your next Governor, I will unequivocally protect the right for anyone — regardless of where they live, their age, gender, race, income level, or the manner in which they became pregnant — to receive abortion care in Oregon. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = Thank you for taking the time to read this. | | Friend, I’m Taylor Pansing Brooks — Patty’s son and a proud LGBTQ+ Nebraskan. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48401240/358096924/333259033?amount=25&refcode=em_220727_fromtaylor&sourceid=1030989&ms=em_220727_fromtaylor&refcode2=18b4b882-e20d-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOGI0Yjg4Mi1lMjBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ua9dX2EbsC5AY7Sy4RBi7WP2tUZZXoyaUXElSIFCd_8=) I wanted to reach out because frankly, it’s **unconscionable** that our legislators continue to vote against what _should_ be our most fundamental human right: _The right to love whomever we love._ Nebraska hasn’t always been kind to our LGBTQ+ neighbors, and I’m grateful every day that I grew up in a family that has loved and accepted me every moment of every day, without reservation. Over the last eight years, my mom has fought fiercely on the floor of the Nebraska Legislature for people like me to live and love without fear of discrimination — at work, in our communities, and in the privacy of our homes. She knows that being gay, or bi, or trans, or gender nonconforming, isn’t a _choice_ — **it’s simply who we are.** The _choice_ lies in whether we come out as our true and authentic selves, or if we continue to suppress the most inextricable parts of our identity because it makes some of our elected officials uncomfortable. **People like Mike Flood are voting to keep us in the shadows. I say it’s time to rise up and vote him out of office this November.** | [VOTE FLOOD OUT THIS NOVEMBER »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48401241/358096926/333259033?amount=25&refcode=em_220727_fromtaylor&sourceid=1030989&ms=em_220727_fromtaylor&refcode2=18b4b882-e20d-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOGI0Yjg4Mi1lMjBkLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ua9dX2EbsC5AY7Sy4RBi7WP2tUZZXoyaUXElSIFCd_8=)

clean_body: He wants us to stay in the shadows — instead, let’s take a stand. | = | | Friend, I’m Taylor Pansing Brooks — Patty’s son and a proud LGBTQ+ Nebraskan. = I wanted to reach out because frankly, it’s unconscionable that our legislators continue to vote against what should be our most fundamental human right: The right to love whomever we love. Nebraska hasn’t always been kind to our LGBTQ+ neighbors, and I’m grateful every day that I grew up in a family that has loved and accepted me every moment of every day, without reservation. Over the last eight years, my mom has fought fiercely on the floor of the Nebraska Legislature for people like me to live and love without fear of discrimination — at work, in our communities, and in the privacy of our homes. She knows that being gay, or bi, or trans, or gender nonconforming, isn’t a choice — it’s simply who we are. The choice lies in whether we come out as our true and authentic selves, or if we continue to suppress the most inextricable parts of our identity because it makes some of our elected officials uncomfortable. People like Mike Flood are voting to keep us in the shadows. I say it’s time to rise up and vote him out of office this November. | = My mom has dedicated her career to ensuring all Nebraskans can enjoy our state’s promise to equality before the law. body:
Dear Friend,

Three days after voting against same-sex marriage in the House, PA Rep. Glenn Thompson attended his gay son's wedding.

The hypocrisy is unbelievable! I deeply felt former MA Rep. Joe Kennedy's astonishment when he tweeted: “Can you imagine voting against your own child?” I can't.
Thompson, who represents Pennsylvania's 15th congressional district, called this bill a "stunt for Democrats." In fact, this bill actually protects people in America like his son from the threat of a Supreme Court hell-bent on stripping us of our rights, including same-sex marriage.

He's also one of the 126 House Republicans who backed a failed federal lawsuit to overturn Pres. Biden's win. So, we know he's not only anti-LGBTQ+ rights, but he's trying to take down our democracy.

We progressives need to rise up NOW. Stand with us and help power the movement to protect Pennsylvanians and our democracy from hypocrites like Rep. Thompson.

name: Defend the Constitution
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=44adacda5cc64f83a721afc208810cc8&_e=ELdqMlMP557DDBt-u7T2dqFkcxxMEpXW8MLp6zUv0XYQrBUhMpc2ptsKsWOPqoW7BBMQvjxmh7fP8lWQSlCwcKZi24I_DyfmI-zh_DIGaW5Dm6JkDm87L0clfeZD1C24L6CADOsHfTTlEb6_A_iiLphnrAUlxJEpC7-ciWuG1E2kTvKyV4LTKFzdp757mJwUlSUcfh_taKBRIEzTTuS6iTCuv5TtHUgN-fsXQCaaeroJ6BSz-adX5ZgpRFzI7k8-pOLbLsIPm8gaHYXh0qAqGTUDnO6uCGNISUnMP6WJbIV2-oB9MEHO19dLHCa9SSA8Gl0TwitvqmGr8PxQbuGCN1RhOhNvizHI42yiSu-6CAoUBCwxb3x6ZJq7xdjwAcrIGG3a4zgJK7EkcnJ522y3vWCgETvBk1m4_dgqv1A7PvY0SmvvUdHMsQGK59xs0AOKq8LJQYcrc_AM08XqhCy0CA%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=44adacda5cc64f83a721afc208810cc8&_e=ELdqMlMP557DDBt-u7T2dqFkcxxMEpXW8MLp6zUv0XYQrBUhMpc2ptsKsWOPqoW7BBMQvjxmh7fP8lWQSlCwcKZi24I_DyfmI-zh_DIGaW5Dm6JkDm87L0clfeZD1C24L6CADOsHfTTlEb6_A_iiLphnrAUlxJEpC7-ciWuG1E2kTvKyV4LTKFzdp757mJwUlSUcfh_taKBRIEzTTuS6iTCuv5TtHUgN-fsXQCaaerpnaTxXvNvpj7OHaL7_yAliHcTeyyrkiwSMOheIDxmALE1Qx6wbg3rSis6Kq_hefFZcypSKI68hYi_XTbpn_PnY2G1TyvmRhcBISXQnuoAwHPISfbysBPg0UwrFEyrlDK0upQccYfMr8RkrmCUm9PON5gyWskbqGMq8PlkN_TSs4LFK7eVZJocFQF8IWOiaNs2a6tzF7HkKh3esbHI9wDJWp-fLa2RGPxshF8J_tBExQQ%3D%3D)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America -_Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you’re thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, “what about them is influential?!”

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren’t, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That’s why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

**HOW BLEXIT Works**

**Step One:** We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods.

**Step Two:** We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy.

We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time.

Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses.

As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them.

**Step Three:** Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media.

BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families.

**Step Four:** We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities.

clean_body: Friend, I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America -Black Lives Matter. Now, I know what you’re thinking... What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis? I ask, “what about them is influential?!” This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities? No. They aren’t, but BLM is. BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations. I saw the hypocrisy long ago. That’s why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. BLEXIT is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I’ll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support. How I Started BLEXIT I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans. With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me. This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever. I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM. Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the “Black Lives Matter” organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn’t have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others. Now, I’m giving back to the Black community to make sure they don’t become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes. BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law. BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them. BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character. BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. Here’s how you can help: I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities. This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter. BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today: HOW BLEXIT Works Step One: We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods. Step Two: We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy. We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time. Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses. As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them. Step Three: Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media. BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families. Step Four: We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities. What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a “DO” tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods. Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man. We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods. So, please, I implore you to send any amount you generously can. We are a 501(c)(3) organization, and your support is tax-deductible. People ask me, “What does BLEXIT mean?” It is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. “If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor.” - Candace Owens We believe in Faith, Freedom, and Family. With those three principles intact, you can find prosperity no matter how your life may have started. And I believe that is what will save us all in the end. Thank you, Brandon Tatum Co-Founder BLEXIT Foundation Sent to Conservatives Give subscribers. 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

Friends and Supporters,

1974! That’s the year Democrats won control of New Jersey’s First Congressional District.

New polling suggests we are the campaign that will end that run.

Here we are in July and we’re only five points down.

We have an excellent opportunity to end the political career of Donald Norcross and stop the political cartel that rules South Jersey. With your continued help we can make that happen.

Will you help me defeat Donald Norcross and the political cartel that rules South Jersey with [a secure online donation of $25, $50, $100, $250, $500 or more](https://gustafson2020.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba5e7e0a5845291a429fa4275&id=70ae94ac35&e=de0c9ca771) today?

The head of South Jersey’s political cartel, Donald’s big brother, has called two meetings to try to get their team in line.

We have to strike now – before the Democrats can mobilize. [Can you help with a donation, of any amount up to $2,900, today](https://gustafson2020.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ba5e7e0a5845291a429fa4275&id=4757b490fd&e=de0c9ca771)?

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, the
Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee (DCCC) is doing something
dangerous.

The DCCC is spending money in Republican primaries to support far-right
Trump Republicans because corporate Democrats *think* they have a better
chance of beating the dangerous, extreme GOP candidates.

It’s misguided, it’s wrong, and it’s dangerous. This is yesterday’s
headline in the New York Times:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/112322?refcode=em20220727-24468&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=24468%2E1203867%2Esqy4Km ]Text: Democrats Aid Far-Right Candidate Against Republican Who Backed
Impeachment

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/112322?refcode=em20220727-24468&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=24468%2E1203867%2Esqy4Km ]Support our work to elect progressive leaders like AOC, Rashida Tlaib,
and Cori Bush with a $3 donation. Justice Democrats relies
on small-dollar donations and will NEVER use your support to help
Republicans.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/112322?refcode=em20220727-24468&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=24468%2E1203867%2Esqy4Km ]Contribute

The Democratic Party should NOT be spending close to half a million on
advertising that promotes Republican candidates. And that’s just the money
they’ve spent in ONE Michigan Republican primary. Democratic groups have
helped Trump’s candidates in Arizona, Pennsylvania, and elsewhere.

Democrats shouldn’t be trying to orchestrate a result in a Republican
primary that they think will benefit their chances in November. It’s
dangerous and it could very well help elect worse Republicans to Congress.

If the Democratic Party spent time and money promoting the policies that
matter to the people, we wouldn’t see news stories like this. But the DCCC
is more concerned with what corporations and Wall Street want. That’s how
it raised $40.7 million last quarter from big corporate donors. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/112322?refcode=em20220727-24468&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=24468%2E1203867%2Esqy4Km ]With
your support, we can raise a tiny fraction of that, defeat corporate
Democrats, and transform the Democratic Party.

The DCCC’s tens of millions will go towards advertising campaigns
supporting Trump-endorsed candidates and electing corporate Democrats that
don’t support Medicare for All or a Green New Deal. The political status
quo is broken,
Peter.

Justice Democrats spends our grassroots dollars on electing champions for
the people and working towards transforming the Democratic Party — so we
have a party that works for the people.

Can we count on your support,
Peter? [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/112322?refcode=em20220727-24468&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1024&akid=24468%2E1203867%2Esqy4Km ]Help us fight back
against the DCCC’s corporate-backed campaigns with a donation today.
$3 will fuel our work to re-elect the Squad, expand our JD
bloc in Congress, and transform the Democratic Party.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/112322?refcode=em20220727-24468&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1025&akid=24468%2E1203867%2Esqy4Km ]Contribute

We appreciate anything you can give and all the ways you support our
movement. We know we can only do this together with you.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

body:
It's going to take a widespread, grassroots effort to keep our anti-racist progressive movement in Congress.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220727-3251-header&t=1&akid=3251%2E2526796%2EbnwFpg)
Hi, it's Cori.
I'm personally writing to you today because we have exactly 6 days until Missouri's August primary election, and I'm up against a well-funded, corporate-backed challenge.
This race has become a litmus test for the strength of our movement for Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and the anti-racist agenda our communities need — and special interests and far-right groups are spending huge amounts of money to support my opponents.
I'm proud to have Alex's support in my race, but it's going to take a widespread, grassroots effort to keep our movement in Congress.
**That's why I have to ask:** [Will you consider making a donation to fund my people-powered campaign for transformative change today?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220727.gYu-c2&refcode=em20220727-3251-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3251%2E2526796%2EbnwFpg)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220727.gYu-c2&refcode=em20220727-3251-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=3251%2E2526796%2EbnwFpg)**
Alex and I have had each other's backs from the very beginning.
Justice Democrats first recruited us both to run for public office back in 2017. We met in Kentucky, quickly finding solidarity as sisters in struggle fighting for our communities. Just a few months later, Alex shocked the country, defeating the establishment and opening the door for everyday people in Congress.
A few weeks later, we were talking about how she could help my campaign. Alex was planning to come to the district when I was t-boned and hit by a car. I was struggling to walk, but Alex still came to the district to help me knock doors — literally putting her arm around me to help me go from door-to-door. Her support meant the world to me. 💜
Two years later we were in Congress together. And, I’ll never forget when we heard that Congress was adjourning and going on vacation after failing to extend the housing eviction moratorium. It was just the two of us standing out there and we knew we had to do something – so I asked her what do you think about staying out on the steps and not going home? Together, we led an action for five days and pressured the Biden administration to take action.
I’m so proud to call Alex my sister-in-service. We both share common struggles that inspire our work in Congress and together we’re determined to deliver transformative change to our communities.
**But first, we need to make sure Alex and I can continue fighting in Congress.** My corporate-backed opponent has the support of establishment groups looking to replace our movement for transformative change with a candidate who promises to uphold the status quo — along with the resources of GOP super PACs. We need to ensure we have the resources to fight back against their attacks in these final days and get our people-first message out.
[Please, we still have a lot of work ahead of us to deliver real change for MO-01. Will you chip in to power my re-election campaign today so Alexandria and I can keep organizing and legislating together in Congress?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220727.gYu-c2&refcode=em20220727-3251-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3251%2E2526796%2EbnwFpg)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220727.gYu-c2&refcode=em20220727-3251-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=3251%2E2526796%2EbnwFpg)**
Thank you for all of your support.
Cori

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220727?refcode=em20220727-3251-P_FND_ANO_END&t=24&refcode2=3251_2526796_bnwFpg&akid=3251%2E2526796%2EbnwFpg)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20220727-3251-P_FND_ANO_END&t=25&akid=3251%2E2526796%2EbnwFpg)**

I’m talking about the insensitive, disgusting video daring President Biden to “come and get” his AR-15 that _he posted on the day the Uvalde massacre report was released._

Honestly, I’m speechless.

How could anyone think this is ok? **It’s not.**

[**If you’re just as appalled with Ronny Jackson’s disgraceful behavior, will you help send a message to him that Texas’ 13th District is ready for new leadership?**](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=0ee629b36b&e=4712f71bea)

**Ronny Jackson just keeps proving to us that he is the _wrong_ person for this job.**

body:
Hi Everyone!!

I wanted to reach out about our weekend events for 100 Days Out from November 8th! We have many volunteer opportunities to support Senator Taddeo's campaign! We will be phonebanking in the afternoons and canvassing during the day! There's also a great opportunity to pick up yard signs at our canvassing locations this weekend! Here's the schedule below, please make sure to sign up on our Mobilize link so we can accurately count volunteers and capacity for the weekend!

With only 100 days left till Election Day, we need your help to send Senator Taddeo to Congress!

**Saturday**
**Pinecrest Door Knocking -[SIGN UP HERE](https://www.mobilize.us/buildthehousefl/event/476222/)**
10am - 11am
5pm - 6pm

**Coral Gables Door Knocking -[SIGN UP HERE](https://www.mobilize.us/buildthehousefl/event/476226/)**
10am - 11am
5pm - 6pm

**Virtual Phonebanking -[ SIGN UP HERE](https://www.mobilize.us/buildthehousefl/event/471227/)**
6pm - 7pm

**Sunday 100 DAYS OUT!**
****
**Pinecrest Door Knocking -[SIGN UP HERE](https://www.mobilize.us/buildthehousefl/event/476222/)**
5pm - 6pm

**Coral Gables Door Knocking -[SIGN UP HERE](https://www.mobilize.us/buildthehousefl/event/476226/)**
4pm - 5pm

**Virtual Phonebanking (with Florida College Dems)-[ SIGN UP HERE](https://www.mobilize.us/buildthehousefl/event/471227/) **
6:30pm - 7pm

Thank you for your commitment to this campaign! We look forward to seeing you all this weekend! If you have any questions, please feel free to email or call me at 954-825-1276 or [afanador@dccc.org](mailto:afanador@dccc.org)

See you soon!

Angélica Afanador

Peter,
I'm truly grateful for staunch allies like you.
_**It wouldn 't be right to go another day without expressing my gratitude for your unwavering support of my re-election campaign.**_
As Election Day nears, I'm taking some time to think back over the events that unfolded during my first term as Governor.
Do you remember Biden's Democrat allies in the legacy media running to cover for Dr. Fauci by supporting unscientific lockdowns and the harmful masking of our children?
Or the Biden administration blatantly and disgracefully colluding with Big Tech to silence free speech and cancel all dissent during the pandemic?
_Fortunately, they were not the only ones with access to COVID data ..._
As Governor of Florida, I reached out to and spoke with some of the best scientists and doctors in the world at Harvard, Stanford, and Oxford to assess the necessity of the Left's destructive lockdown policies.
**The data showed the Left 's draconian policies were failures, and I kept Florida open. And I'm glad I did.**
**Every American has a right to work.**
**Every business has a right to operate.**
That's why I stepped in and stopped local governments from restricting people from working or operating a business. [_**Do you support my decision to keep Florida open? Stand with me now. >>>**_](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=2ffb1460a1284419b2d8982bf025fa6e&_e=g2cIBgYKPsOfCJw8LCOarz3ihQfHGOch99qmLhyUHU6nbBbXr3xWY2_D-VbiRpMJ82KuaTu_WtvRWcE8sSPGhnNSpbiSooHOtfzwqt-MOsKoErif7Kv8O3FmcClYIOgbgaOEZ5mNUvUoMhOnO3cuKu7ZO5dsHnhk5dM8mplYKYGBkOcmpVkrsMCznUIPgcluymn6q5RdRY5bIlYnw_-fuiARZ4ChK28biaf6cllr62ArHkYvLF1NZQwD7mpdE4oiDBktsZCTbxtJZlxSbt9b4l22kfValbvelEnSrJzcOLfRyrPPm8N1IKlvkVsbdfHowwkv9TQlSXKLuwHztM4xF5cmp3kH8Z_bt26ImU_EELjBLiYOMcg91XzBlm521dnoTrYrDlQkOWGFqy9fmc1Ksw%3D%3D)
I even issued pardons for those who were threatened by local governments with jail and ridiculous fines for operating during the pandemic.
I put my entire political career on the line to Keep Florida Free. _**I fought back.**_
It showed you exactly the kind of leader I am. I don't cower with fear about what the media may say -- _I just lead_.
In 2019, when I was inaugurated as Florida's 46th Governor, I didn't let the grass grow under my feet before turning the Tallahassee establishment upside down.
I immediately fulfilled several of my key campaign promises to Floridians, including:
✅ Changing the Florida Supreme Court for a generation by appointing three rock-solid conservative justices.
✅ Signing the largest expansion of school choice in the nation, giving parents greater freedom to choose the education that best meets their child's needs.
✅ Restoring election integrity by holding election officials accountable by accepting the resignation of Broward County Supervisor of Elections Brenda Snipes from public office, as well as suspending Palm Beach County Election Supervisor Susan Bucher.
✅ Suspending Broward County Sheriff Scott Israel for his failure to protect the students at Marjorie Stoneman Douglas High School during the massacre at Parkland in 2018.
Of course, making these moves during my first few days in office was just a preview of what I set out to accomplish.
**Over my first three years, I 've continued to steer Florida to a strong, safe, prosperous future with liberty as my guide and the Constitutions as my north star.**
[_**Do you think Florida is headed in the right direction? Rush in any amount now to keep our accomplishments going for another four years!**_](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=2ffb1460a1284419b2d8982bf025fa6e&_e=g2cIBgYKPsOfCJw8LCOarz3ihQfHGOch99qmLhyUHU6nbBbXr3xWY2_D-VbiRpMJ82KuaTu_WtvRWcE8sSPGhnNSpbiSooHOtfzwqt-MOsKoErif7Kv8O3FmcClYIOgbgaOEZ5mNUvUoMhOnO3cuKu7ZO5dsHnhk5dM8mplYKYGBkOcmpVkrsMCznUIPgclu3eQRW78DFi6tPzO1Y2h-waD_zozIPy09a-3BGwIExLYjb5MxxkMQTfoMnHu93RI_PxsEpevB81EBBOHlNSCOG5rHYr0NM93n1D-3rPy4j1xXrOO6n7JGs6ZgH4iYFACKbXvMcy85vCU-LrbM6R-6jOW2Oz1hsvrWvWSC_s_gyfEVZ3IOujjQguXuSJLh2ieFeqgb3Wsy7ZRqQATAkeRvfA%3D%3D)
I refuse to simply kick the can down the road or seek out the path of least resistance when it comes to doing the right thing.
I certainly don't set my priorities according to what is preferred by Silicon Valley's CEOs, Big Tech's shady algorithms, or the corrupt media's agenda!
I refuse to bow to pressure from the Biden administration, kiss the ring of power-hungry government bureaucrats like Fauci, or follow orders from woke corporations who want to dictate to us how to live and what to think.
**I was elected to lead, not to follow.**
As was the case when I was in the U.S. Navy, my mission has always been to advocate for the people I serve.
I'm proud that because of my work these last few years, Florida is known as _the freest state in the country._

body:
In just 6 days, the reproductive justice movement is facing its first big test on the ballot since the overturning of Roe v. Wade. | | | Peter, In just 6 days, the reproductive justice movement is facing its first big test on the ballot since the overturning of _Roe v. Wade._ Kansans going to the polls this Tuesday will be asked to vote on a constitutional amendment that would state that the right to an abortion is not protected by the Kansas Constitution. If this amendment passes, the Kansas legislature will act quickly to ban and criminalize abortion. But there’s still time to fight back. **Kansans for Constitutional Freedom is holding phone banks every day through Election Day to urge voters to vote NO on removing the right to an abortion in Kansas.[Will you sign up for a phone bank shift this week to connect with voters and help defeat this amendment on August 2? Click here to RSVP.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTDECWgxy79ZJRdvCCil7G2uBqacuHYq5QsqTLCx3Twy5-AweXTon-rTk6Cxbu3C6L3ymw6QInPdnpbtDdyqdnDkg0v-JC1zPjNn7oyMvZ0m7o4RCHHeBYwIeHuUqkamkYQ8eBoZgFP6cuRCF5Sqmmbae6rxf5BV1-LTzeX0m_vgh10QqAxGLS7KLCcxocT5XwSR7gkSc7YosQobZJz5Ak32qNXL_vdHl_q3VYwruRh-FnF4BLGAIgfyOy4ou4ahezRopJzkvibhyfeQ1a9zYMbkScBu_OOj-D1m_Z5kSyS9JAMWYHktTOGYbVCjKnNXa_IhpeADjxYR65aC6QS5K-hlY7lDzJaBVOZpYWm4d4xVcRj3v64yYz_gF-cqdtGMRsLlLHu_yqYELo-2CLGU1PwIjrnxf_Ii1bHqO2UdbyKKf/3o3/vzvQpq89RN-RNOB_3JVqHA/h0/s3zsp1S8OS5RgdqALFGxWu73OfDjSkKkiAJo6LMtDxU)** **[Phonebank for Abortion Rights](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTDECWgxy79ZJRdvCCil7G2uBqacuHYq5QsqTLCx3Twy5-AweXTon-rTk6Cxbu3C6L3ymw6QInPdnpbtDdyqdnDkg0v-JC1zPjNn7oyMvZ0m7o4RCHHeBYwIeHuUqkamkYbFh_hafeT1ejumNhxckVoUtHs2Hq1slBpSe24kYrpuobGffmO4YE0JIpw4ZHE-pRgMBLZr_kProSI59mNZsiGRrftDuZ5Dj8eiEtm0ktPIKoxn9_X8DDvy1ckOIAJNoQUajtMdDztT4gceEYHWxUqzUjyap-sVAvEr9yl6k-L1imHU5lMKm5k7VwG5lZp2ad9NSiRjJLOhNyqVwFW5SeMr45_p5TXg_1p29WnTtriTJVSxChYCcNHPqYI6Fc75kv1TymRfH5GhYrSb2YD0QMOFA8aJwWEgv3QjUbSNdaNe7/3o3/vzvQpq89RN-RNOB_3JVqHA/h1/vGoqUl7Y83tyki7Cu_FJqt601gGpDohY4OpiwBpQ3tY)** **Here’s the good news:** The majority of people support the freedom to have an abortion – on both sides of the aisle. In Kansas, 50.5% of residents believe that the state should not place any limitations on who can get an abortion, with only a quarter of people supporting limiting access, and just 5% of Kansans are in favor of a total ban on abortion in the state.1 **People across the country understand that abortions are necessary health care, and that our neighbors and loved ones deserve the freedom to make that decision for themselves.** **But the right wing in Kansas is working hard to subvert democracy and push this unpopular ban through.** They’ve pushed ads that range from highly misleading to full-on lies, phrased the amendment as confusingly as they could, and scheduled this vote for a lower-turnout election to discourage their constituents from making their voices heard. **Recent polls show this referendum is going to come down to the wire, and every vote contact we make gets us closer to preserving the right to an abortion in Kansas.** **** **[No matter where you live, you can take action for abortion rights now. clean_body: In just 6 days, the reproductive justice movement is facing its first big test on the ballot since the overturning of Roe v. Wade. | | | Peter, In just 6 days, the reproductive justice movement is facing its first big test on the ballot since the overturning of Roe v. Wade. Kansans going to the polls this Tuesday will be asked to vote on a constitutional amendment that would state that the right to an abortion is not protected by the Kansas Constitution. If this amendment passes, the Kansas legislature will act quickly to ban and criminalize abortion. But there’s still time to fight back. Kansans for Constitutional Freedom is holding phone banks every day through Election Day to urge voters to vote NO on removing the right to an abortion in Kansas. Here’s the good news: The majority of people support the freedom to have an abortion – on both sides of the aisle. In Kansas, 50.5% of residents believe that the state should not place any limitations on who can get an abortion, with only a quarter of people supporting limiting access, and just 5% of Kansans are in favor of a total ban on abortion in the state.1 People across the country understand that abortions are necessary health care, and that our neighbors and loved ones deserve the freedom to make that decision for themselves. But the right wing in Kansas is working hard to subvert democracy and push this unpopular ban through. They’ve pushed ads that range from highly misleading to full-on lies, phrased the amendment as confusingly as they could, and scheduled this vote for a lower-turnout election to discourage their constituents from making their voices heard. Recent polls show this referendum is going to come down to the wire, and every vote contact we make gets us closer to preserving the right to an abortion in Kansas. ** In solidarity, Working Families Party Source: 1\. , Vox, July 27, 2022 Thoughts? body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220727&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220727&amount=28]
Friend,
There’s a bit of a running joke on my team that has developed into somewhat of a motto since 2018. Team Slotkin: leaping over a very low bar.
This came about when folks continuously expressed their amazement that we were doing things that – up until then – we had considered pretty basic. Things like visiting small businesses and listening to business owners, learning the lay of the land from local leaders, and making an effort to speak with folks on all sides of an issue impacting their community. Oh yes, and then ACTUALLY following up with direct action. I’ve even been thanked for “speaking like a normal person.” I realized that the reason people were thanking me for such basic things is because their expectations of elected officials are sadly, painfully low.
There are some small communities, in particular, that have not had a Democrat come to visit in decades. As a result, they are surprised when I show up, and downright amazed when I’ve done my homework. Things that should be a given for anyone running for office.
For the past 6 months, our strategy has been to run this campaign as if I’m running for mayor in 30 small towns at once. All I do is sit down with people and dig in on how to get things done at the hyper-local level, whether it’s helping to build a badly-needed sewer system, or a new sidewalk, or a new library. It’s a ton of detailed work but we’ve been able to do it with the help of our generous grassroots supporters. So as we head into the final stages of this election when things really kick into high gear, your contribution, large or small, helps us get where we need to go. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220727&amount=28]
It may be a low bar, but I’m determined to continue leaping over it as high as I possibly can.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220727&amount=28]
Elissa
