body:
**[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=f6a1646d4bd8424185febdabe7e83dcd&_e=SqE6Rj0k9hRrChw37A1MbLQGnmayCFHnx2YOfCD288qHdhubwUsb7C-_rdYGs62V3CfpHr-fpqLli-_JQ0bESBiELymDj2r_TbdPw2NQ69Uuf_kTLU0y_RK1XJYCZv53mQwTIO7FJlubEedcXKRVqhX49gBtbgjbgA-sNzg70v43DfwziWoH-J6BTiILIj4thUlkgprjsuxoLgAqdivGASsmavL-z2e7wf_oJdAqxH47c9aVCsnOMLhrLvTK8_IoVzSHvWwITzWD95YKf-YumVVWif6huCKkKCwLY20Whahj7I5ihTf2L1p5uTTKoWPeNXA-Xaw3nnoZxK0n0CMR1DPYjW0sBDqa683g4vkAH1fPNFRJ8TyF4Ftx8RxJJubzpnCgLTciLOBii5QDEtMpLQ%3D%3D)**

Peter,
I'm truly grateful for staunch allies like you.
_**It wouldn 't be right to go another day without expressing my gratitude for your unwavering support of my re-election campaign.**_
As Election Day nears, I'm taking some time to think back over the events that unfolded during my first term as Governor.
Do you remember Biden's Democrat allies in the legacy media running to cover for Dr. Fauci by supporting unscientific lockdowns and the harmful masking of our children?
Or the Biden administration blatantly and disgracefully colluding with Big Tech to silence free speech and cancel all dissent during the pandemic?
_Fortunately, they were not the only ones with access to COVID data ..._
As Governor of Florida, I reached out to and spoke with some of the best scientists and doctors in the world at Harvard, Stanford, and Oxford to assess the necessity of the Left's destructive lockdown policies.
**The data showed the Left 's draconian policies were failures, and I kept Florida open. And I'm glad I did.**
**Every American has a right to work.**
**Every business has a right to operate.**
That's why I stepped in and stopped local governments from restricting people from working or operating a business. [_**Do you support my decision to keep Florida open? Stand with me now. >>>**_](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=f6a1646d4bd8424185febdabe7e83dcd&_e=SqE6Rj0k9hRrChw37A1MbLQGnmayCFHnx2YOfCD288qHdhubwUsb7C-_rdYGs62V3CfpHr-fpqLli-_JQ0bESBiELymDj2r_TbdPw2NQ69Uuf_kTLU0y_RK1XJYCZv53mQwTIO7FJlubEedcXKRVqhX49gBtbgjbgA-sNzg70v43DfwziWoH-J6BTiILIj4tFwso03hBMpeI5ZOpW7rXfge3DOtsjbt2dQAoAe09Jo290Ddei-exkkzX9B4stQXdOKnrqSnGe6EvobBjFJ1J1W_rQ4J-FBmmkVrjW6T0NKJfkzG882ekYhwhsfazA5Ig3nC7cwKHoPA5bxFfrHJxj_8kWQ3c3gYpIxsiTsvQxNuKEq22cSPOWvzZ1amQpBg40erzmTzx_EDa5DIDFZAbTQ%3D%3D)
I even issued pardons for those who were threatened by local governments with jail and ridiculous fines for operating during the pandemic.
I put my entire political career on the line to Keep Florida Free. _**I fought back.**_
It showed you exactly the kind of leader I am. I don't cower with fear about what the media may say -- _I just lead_.
In 2019, when I was inaugurated as Florida's 46th Governor, I didn't let the grass grow under my feet before turning the Tallahassee establishment upside down.
I immediately fulfilled several of my key campaign promises to Floridians, including:
✅ Changing the Florida Supreme Court for a generation by appointing three rock-solid conservative justices.
✅ Signing the largest expansion of school choice in the nation, giving parents greater freedom to choose the education that best meets their child's needs.
✅ Restoring election integrity by holding election officials accountable by accepting the resignation of Broward County Supervisor of Elections Brenda Snipes from public office, as well as suspending Palm Beach County Election Supervisor Susan Bucher.
✅ Suspending Broward County Sheriff Scott Israel for his failure to protect the students at Marjorie Stoneman Douglas High School during the massacre at Parkland in 2018.
Of course, making these moves during my first few days in office was just a preview of what I set out to accomplish.
**Over my first three years, I 've continued to steer Florida to a strong, safe, prosperous future with liberty as my guide and the Constitutions as my north star.**
[_**Do you think Florida is headed in the right direction? Rush in any amount now to keep our accomplishments going for another four years!**_](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=f6a1646d4bd8424185febdabe7e83dcd&_e=SqE6Rj0k9hRrChw37A1MbLQGnmayCFHnx2YOfCD288qHdhubwUsb7C-_rdYGs62V3CfpHr-fpqLli-_JQ0bESBiELymDj2r_TbdPw2NQ69Uuf_kTLU0y_RK1XJYCZv53mQwTIO7FJlubEedcXKRVqhX49gBtbgjbgA-sNzg70v43DfwziWoH-J6BTiILIj4tdCyUG4U3ifdMNfWSm5xt3R9w2lp-_hgnKVgs_ZgZ6t0B4kFL7meAEfBVmjDO54cw4EI8-E3VlKNrWFiDp9pobvBk89sGNdoBpsMO2dgfOILuBFjKP2nmD0q5Ywxy2qeT0WoPqoOioqM7EiubWYEALZDt314mN4lW7hEjv3JLP-QL4MfWUwDhmfmWZITA6mNfSqYz-dr5wLa3K0JYrIb4XQ%3D%3D)
I refuse to simply kick the can down the road or seek out the path of least resistance when it comes to doing the right thing.
I certainly don't set my priorities according to what is preferred by Silicon Valley's CEOs, Big Tech's shady algorithms, or the corrupt media's agenda!
I refuse to bow to pressure from the Biden administration, kiss the ring of power-hungry government bureaucrats like Fauci, or follow orders from woke corporations who want to dictate to us how to live and what to think.
**I was elected to lead, not to follow.**
As was the case when I was in the U.S. Navy, my mission has always been to advocate for the people I serve.
I'm proud that because of my work these last few years, Florida is known as _the freest state in the country._
Yet rather than celebrate our economy, our school children being freed of compulsory masking, and the influx of overtaxed Americans who are voting with their feet to move to Florida, I am being attacked by my Democrat opponents.
I know you understand that coordinated attacks and vitriol against a successful conservative Republican like me is business as usual from the lockdown Democrats. It's pathetic to see my political opponents and detractors whine about my record of accomplishments.
**As Governor of Florida, I 'll never stop defending the pro-liberty, pro-free market policies that make Florida the beachhead of freedom for the nation.**
My re-election campaign sent SHOCK WAVES through the Democrat media complex when we announced a $5 MILLION ad reservation targeting Hispanic voters.
With the Biden regime publicly cozying up to communist dictators in Cuba and Venezuela, you can be sure every victim of communism across the state is more willing than ever to reject the Democrat Party's choice for Governor this November.
**I 'm going to battle for every vote.**
As you may remember, I narrowly won by a margin of just 0.4% four years ago during my first race for Governor!
We truly must be prepared for another knock-down, drag-out fight.
Now, with just months to go until Election Day, I'm asking you to stand with me again by making another generous contribution to my campaign today.
With November fast approaching, I'm hoping you can double your most generous gift.
[**[PLEDGE YOUR GIFT NOW]**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=f6a1646d4bd8424185febdabe7e83dcd&_e=SqE6Rj0k9hRrChw37A1MbLQGnmayCFHnx2YOfCD288qHdhubwUsb7C-_rdYGs62V3CfpHr-fpqLli-_JQ0bESBiELymDj2r_TbdPw2NQ69Uuf_kTLU0y_RK1XJYCZv53mQwTIO7FJlubEedcXKRVqhX49gBtbgjbgA-sNzg70v43DfwziWoH-J6BTiILIj4tvjFdYIYsHrrkmaGHZxdEz1UPRM9ADYWfkMK_p_pywGc8lsb8Hmg-vJLEwi35-OP8_VNUBqTS3I22QYuRMLQtM-JpuLriSg8TwJvg8SUY17G6rHHW-mR6f4guq_-Ko-dk0ZP2gW9UJ65DDY4eJOkFHWq9B9G1kc-76m0Fxy3IwZ17UMkurg_iQuC0K3ECsV8w44pErOMzDCK4wY-_HLZi8Q%3D%3D)
Regardless of the amount, I simply must have your continued support to be ready to respond to the next round of distortions and lies my Biden-loving opponents hurl at me.
_Peter, I 'm incredibly grateful to you for your continued support._
No matter the amount, I thank you in advance for continuing to stand with me as I lead by example and fight back against the heavy hand of Biden's big government.
For Florida,
Ron DeSantis

body:

| **\--------- OFFICIAL MEMO: SALAZAR FOR CONGRESS ---------**
---
Peter,
---
As one of my biggest supporters, I wanted to share this official campaign memo with you so you know where we're at with a little over 100 days until November 8th:
---
THE BAD NEWS:
---
* Polling shows a close race, with one poll even showing Taddeo within the margin of error.
* The _Cook Political Report_ shifted our race ranking towards the Democrats and now ranks my district as EVEN on its Partisan Voter Index Scale (PVI).
* Pelosi's DCCC gave my opponent Annette Taddeo a priority pass by adding her to the DCCC's Red to Blue program - and they've put a $5 million target on my back.
* The Democrats have identified my seat as their "best hope" of flipping a congressional district in Florida and saving Nancy Pelosi's House majority.
* At this morning's finance meeting, we were still **$14,443** short of our July fundraising goal.

---
THE GOOD NEWS:
---
* Polling also shows we have a narrow but stable lead - and when undecided voters learn about Taddeo's support for the failed Biden-Harris agenda, they overwhelmingly break our way.
* Overall, we're still favored to WIN in November by both _538_ and the _Cook Political Report._
* We outraised Taddeo and posted our biggest fundraising numbers of the cycle last quarter.
* We're getting reinforcement from national conservatives who know how important it is for us to hold this critical seat so we can END Pelosi's House majority.
* I know I can count on my grassroots supporters to come through for me before Sunday.

---
I promise you, Peter, I will ALWAYS defend freedom and fight for you in Congress.
---

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Trump just called me evil, sick, a watermelon head, shifty and unattractive. No, seriously.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=556%2E5257348%2EZTZdP- ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Derek,

Yesterday afternoon, the twice-impeached disgraced former president was
back at it. This time, at his America First Summit.

In the space of an hour-long speech, here’s just some of what Donald Trump
said about me, and let me tell you, the repeated attacks were a doozy.

Let’s take Trump’s insults one by one. First comes the attack on my
character:

“He knows it’s a hoax. Not a stupid person, an evil person, a sick person, in my
opinion.”

Next comes the childish insults:

"He stood pompously before the microphones, his head, as you know, I feel,
shaped like a watermelon."

Wait a minute. A few months ago he was calling me a pencil neck. Now it’s
watermelon head? A watermelon head on top of a pencil neck — now that’s a
pretty tough balancing act.

Finally, Trump makes it clear that I’m apparently not his type:

“He’s quite an unattractive man. Now, they’ll get me in trouble for that,
because by saying he’s unattractive, they’ll say that’s a horrible thing to say.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jul2022_abs_em.4MLSU6&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_IN30_20220727_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=556%2E5257348%2EZTZdP- ][IMG]

Oh Donald, you wound me. (For the record, my wife, Eve, says I’m very
handsome. So there. She also had a few choice things to say about Trump,
which I can’t reproduce here).

It might be funny if he wasn’t the former president. It would be, maybe
just a little sad and pathetic. But this infantile man is still the most
powerful man in the GOP. Which means we cannot laugh off his attacks.

Donald Trump knows exactly what he’s doing. He’s telling his supporters
and most devoted MAGA base to demonize his enemies. And he’s repeatedly
targeted me because he apparently thinks I’m “smart” and therefore
effective, that is, a threat to him. Four attacks in just the last week.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=jul2022_abs_em.4MLSU6&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_IN30_20220727_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=556%2E5257348%2EZTZdP- ]That’s why I’m asking if you can help me fight back. When you support
me each time he attacks me, it means his every insult goes into defeating
him and his GOP enablers at the polls. Can you help our campaign fight
back against Trump?

clean_body: [ - ]Adam Schiff for Congress Derek, Yesterday afternoon, the twice-impeached disgraced former president was back at it. This time, at his America First Summit. In the space of an hour-long speech, here’s just some of what Donald Trump said about me, and let me tell you, the repeated attacks were a doozy. Let’s take Trump’s insults one by one. First comes the attack on my character: “He knows it’s a hoax. Not a stupid person, an evil person, a sick person, in my opinion.” Next comes the childish insults: "He stood pompously before the microphones, his head, as you know, I feel, shaped like a watermelon." Wait a minute. A few months ago he was calling me a pencil neck. Now it’s watermelon head? A watermelon head on top of a pencil neck — now that’s a pretty tough balancing act. Finally, Trump makes it clear that I’m apparently not his type: “He’s quite an unattractive man. Now, they’ll get me in trouble for that, because by saying he’s unattractive, they’ll say that’s a horrible thing to say. [ - ][IMG] Oh Donald, you wound me. (For the record, my wife, Eve, says I’m very handsome. So there. She also had a few choice things to say about Trump, which I can’t reproduce here). It might be funny if he wasn’t the former president. It would be, maybe just a little sad and pathetic. But this infantile man is still the most powerful man in the GOP. Which means we cannot laugh off his attacks. Donald Trump knows exactly what he’s doing. He’s telling his supporters and most devoted MAGA base to demonize his enemies. And he’s repeatedly targeted me because he apparently thinks I’m “smart” and therefore effective, that is, a threat to him. Four attacks in just the last week. [ - ]That’s why I’m asking if you can help me fight back. When you support me each time he attacks me, it means his every insult goes into defeating him and his GOP enablers at the polls. Can you help our campaign fight back against Trump? clean_body: | Hey Peter, I’m writing to you today from my farm in North Carolina, where I’m enjoying the summer. North Carolina is great – we’ve got beautiful beaches, picturesque mountains, and superior barbeque. But there is one bad thing about summer. Unfortunately, summer typically means a drop in our fundraising numbers. And understandably so – people are spending more time outdoors with family and friends, not focusing on politics. I get it. But let me tell you why we can’t lose any momentum, especially right now. 1. While most people are enjoying a nice picnic outside, my Radical Left opponent is posting record-breaking fundraising numbers. She brought in $7.4 million in the last 3 months alone. 2. Every poll is showing an extremely tight race this November. We’re nowhere near a comfortable victory, and everyone knows North Carolina could be the swing seat that decides control of the Senate. 3. With Democrats controlling the House, the Senate, and the White House, it is absolutely crucial we take this seat in order to stop the Biden/Beasley agenda. Chuck Schumer would be elated to have Radical Cheri Beasley in the Senate with him – and we can’t let that happen. | Our work is nowhere near done, and we get closer to November 8th with each passing minute. If everyone reading this email chipped in even just $5, we can make it out of this summer slump relaxed & ready for November. If you have stored your payment information with WinRed, your donation will process immediately. | ---|--- | | | Thanks in advance, Ted Budd | Ted Budd is a father, small business owner, and conservative leader running for Senate in North Carolina. He is the ONLY candidate who is endorsed by President Trump and the only candidate who will fight for the America First Agenda in Washington. | | | Dear Peter,

Sincerely,

Team Gibbs

|
---
| **_Upcoming Events & Volunteer Opportunities_**
**Thursday, July 28th | Muskegon Phone Bank | 4:00pm **
Please bring your smart phone or laptop and come help us call voters at Barclay Place Event Center! This is critical to ensure they remember to vote and have heard about John. We will be making phone calls from 4:00pm - 5:30pm and then enjoying some pizza while we get ready for the **Town Hall at 6:30pm.** Please email dcool@votejohngibbs.com to RSVP.

**Thursday, July 28th | Town Hall | Barclay Place Event Center | 6:30-8:00pm **
Come join John Gibbs and the Muskegon GOP as we gear up for the primary election on August 2nd with a Town Hall! RSVP: [Click Here!](https://votejohngibbs.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=125d68a9918858e87dbc3c37d&id=6548e3217c&e=c238e8971e)

---
| **_Join us Saturday, July 30th! _**
**Saturday, July 30th | Byron Days Parade**
Team Gibbs will be walking in the Byron Days Parade! RSVP at [team@votejohngibbs.com](mailto:team@votejohngibbs.com?subject=RSVP%20-%20Byron%20Days%20Parade) to receive parade details.

**Saturday, July 30th | Door Knocking | 12:00pm - 4:00PM**
Please RSVP to dcool@votejohngibbs.com if your would like to help us Get Out The Vote and knock doors for John! Please include the city/county that you would prefer to work in and we will try to partner you up with a Team Leader in that area.

body:
I feel really good about where we are in this campaign.

At 79,000 people and growing, we’ve got the biggest volunteer organizing
team in the country right now. And these volunteers are already at the
doors of Texas voters, building relationships and connecting with those
who will decide the outcome of this election.

Our digital team is leveraging our social media presence to reach voters —
especially young voters — with the messages that give them a reason to
care about and vote in this election. It’s also been a powerful
recruitment tool to bring in new volunteers.

And Abbott continues to make the case for why he can’t be trusted with
another term in office. Whether it’s the grid, the attacks on teachers,
the failure to end gun violence, or the outright banning of reproductive
freedom in Texas with no exceptions for rape or incest, he’s given Texas
voters — Republicans as well as Democrats — plenty of reasons to vote for
change.

The only place where I know we could be doing even better is fundraising.

While we outraised Abbott in the last reporting period with more than
500,000 contributions, showing the strength of our grassroots donors, we
started this race more than $50 million behind. Abbott continues to have
more money in the bank. I really need us to redouble our commitment to
meeting the very ambitious fundraising goals we’ve set if we’re going to
have the resources to win.

Whether it’s the grid, the attacks on teachers, the failure to end gun violence, or the outright banning of reproductive freedom in Texas with no exceptions for rape or incest, he’s given Texas voters — Republicans as well as Democrats — plenty of reasons to vote for change. The only place where I know we could be doing even better is fundraising. While we outraised Abbott in the last reporting period with more than 500,000 contributions, showing the strength of our grassroots donors, we started this race more than $50 million behind. Abbott continues to have more money in the bank. I really need us to redouble our commitment to meeting the very ambitious fundraising goals we’ve set if we’re going to have the resources to win. [ ]As we approach the end of this month, I hope that you’ll consider making a significant donation to this campaign. I need to make sure that we maximize the momentum we have, the progress we’re making and this extraordinary chance before us to win. [ ]Contribute $3 Thank you, Beto

name: Charles Booker
subject: That’s the kind of fighter I’ll be in the Senate, Peter.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

Over the years, I’ve been proud to stand on the picket lines with
teachers, on the railroad tracks with coal miners, with workers at
Churchill Downs.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220727.Bsd_5p&refcode=em20220727-other-2279&t=1001&akid=2279%2E346206%2ERdtlvv ][IMG]

Together, we held the line for fair wages, the right to unionize, sick
days and paid family leave, and for a shot at bettering our children’s
future. Because that’s what we do in Kentucky,
Peter. It’s part of who we are.
It was in our hills where the labor movement got its legs, and we’ve been
holding the line ever since.

On July 26, 1973, KY Brookside Coal Miners walked off the job and went on
strike. After 13 months, they won and secured a contract. In 2019, when I
stood on the tracks in Harlan with Blackjewel miners, I felt that same
fighting spirit.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220727.Bsd_5p&refcode=em20220727-other-2279&t=1002&akid=2279%2E346206%2ERdtlvv ][IMG]

That’s the kind of fighter I’ll be in the Senate,
Peter. The workers I’ve met are
the very reason why I’m running this election to replace Rand Paul.
Recently, Rand introduced legislation that would nationalize anti-union
policies. Legislation that has proven to reduce worker pay and put more
money in the pockets of the rich. Together, we must vote out politicians
like Rand who are funded by companies that benefit from his anti-union
agenda.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220727.Bsd_5p&refcode=em20220727-other-2279&t=1003&akid=2279%2E346206%2ERdtlvv ]I know if we keep this momentum up we can deliver the changes workers
urgently need in our country. Will you make a $5 donation
right now and show your support for our pro-worker movement?

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220727.Bsd_5p&refcode=em20220727-2279&t=1022&akid=2279%2E346206%2ERdtlvv ]Contribute $5

I’ve always believed that our fates as Kentuckians are intertwined.

The fight for higher wages is connected to the fight for clean water. The
fight for reproductive healthcare is connected to the fight for racial
justice. Because an attack on one of us is an attack on all of us.

We’re so proud of the pro-worker movement we’re building. This is exactly
the kind of momentum we need to make our voices heard this election and
replace Rand Paul.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220727.Bsd_5p&refcode=em20220727-other-2279&t=1023&akid=2279%2E346206%2ERdtlvv ]Will you chip in $5 or anything you can right now to
help us grow this momentum? Every dollar you give helps us contact more
voters across Kentucky and amplify our message for people-first change.

Let’s keep holding the line,

Charles

Contribute to Charles Booker: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-email-donate?refcode=em20220727-2279-footer&t=1024&refcode2=2279_346206_Rdtlvv&akid=2279%2E346206%2ERdtlvv

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe:

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.charlesbooker.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=2279%2E346206%2ERdtlvv

Contributions to Booker for Kentucky are not deductible for federal income tax purposes.

Election Day. We want to be transparent with you about where we are on our
progress to our goal.

Georgians are counting on Stacey to win this November — and she’s counting
on us to raise $1 million before July 31 in our 100 Days Fund so we have
the resources to defeat Brian Kemp. As of right now, we still have a lot
of ground to cover:
